words.ex: He has the ability to solve math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力快速解决数学问题。
words.en: The capacity to do something or the possession of the means or skill to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 参与活动；进行活动
words.ex: Children take activities after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后参与活动。
words.en: To engage in or perform actions, often as part of a routine or plan.

words.tr: adj. 能够；能…的；有能力的；
words.ex: He is able to swim across the river.
words.ex_cn: 他能够游过这条河。
words.en: If you are able to do something, you have the skills, strength, knowledge, or other qualities needed to do it.

words.ex: Human activity causes pollution in the river.
words.ex_cn: 人类活动导致了河流污染。
words.en: Human activity refers to the various actions and behaviors performed by humans, which can have significant impacts on the environment, society, and other living beings.

words.ex: He is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名老师。
words.en: Used to indicate the identity, qualities, or condition of someone or something.

words.ex: He is an actor in a famous movie.
words.ex_cn: 他是电影中的一名演员。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.tr: adv. 事实上；实际上；竟然；
words.ex: I thought he was late, but actually he was on time.
words.ex_cn: 我以为他迟到了，但事实上他准时到了。
words.en: You use actually to indicate that a situation exists or happened, or to emphasize that it is true.

words.tr:
prep. 关于；大约；大概；涉及；
adv. 大约；到处；
words.ex: The book is about animals.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于动物的。
words.en: If you talk about something, you are discussing it or mentioning it. If you do something about a problem, you take action to solve it.

words.ex: He adapts to new rules quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快适应新规则。
words.en: If you adapt to a new situation or adapt yourself to it, you change your ideas or behaviour in order to deal with it successfully.

words.tr: phrase. 对...的关心；对...表示忧虑
words.ex: Parents have concern about their child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 父母对孩子的安全感到担心。
words.en: If you concern about something, you feel worried about it.

words.ex: He adds two and three to get five.
words.ex_cn: 他把二和三相加得到五。
words.en: To put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, or amount.

words.tr:
prep. 在…上面；
adj. 上述的；
adv. 在上面；
words.ex: The book is above the table.
words.ex_cn: 书在桌子上面。
words.en: In or to a higher place than something else; over.

words.ex: The addition of a new chair made the room more comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 增加一把新椅子让房间更舒适了。
words.en: An addition is something that is added to something else, often to improve it or make it larger.

words.ex: He went abroad to study medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他去国外学医。
words.en: In or to a foreign country or countries.

words.ex: He likes apples. In addition, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果。另外，他喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use in addition when you want to mention another item connected with the subject you are discussing.

words.tr:
adj. 学术的；
n. 大学教师；学者；
words.ex: He published an academic paper on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于气候变化的学术论文。
words.en: relating to education, especially at college or university level

words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.ex: He needs an academic qualification to get the job.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一份学术资格才能获得这份工作。
words.en: An academic qualification is an official document showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study or passed an examination.

words.ex: He solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: If you solve a problem or a question, you find a solution or an answer to it.

words.ex: He accepted the gift with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着接受了这份礼物。
words.en: If you accept something that you have been offered, you say yes to it or agree to take it.

words.ex: The ticket is your admission to the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这张票是进入音乐会的许可。
words.en: An admission is a statement in which you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, or the act of allowing someone to enter a place or organization.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.ex: The museum charges an admission fee of five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆收取五美元的入场费。
words.en: A charge for entry to a place, event, or institution.

words.tr: 短语动词. 获得对……的使用权；能够使用或接触到某物
words.ex: Students can get access to the library after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生放学后可以进入图书馆。
words.en: To obtain the right or opportunity to use or see something.

words.tr:
n. 成人；
adj. 成年的；
words.ex: An adult must pay taxes.
words.ex_cn: 成人必须缴税。
words.en: An adult is a mature, fully developed person. An adult has reached the age when they are legally responsible for their actions.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对……有有限的接触或使用权；能够使用但受到限制
words.ex: He has limited access to the library after 9 PM.
words.ex_cn: 他晚上9点后只能有限地使用图书馆。
words.en: To have the ability to use or obtain something only within certain boundaries or conditions.

words.tr:
n. 发展；进步；提前；
adj. 预先的；在前的；
v. 前进；发展；提前；
words.ex: The advance of technology has changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 科技的发展改变了我们的生活。
words.en: If you advance a cause, interest, or claim, you support it and help it to succeed.

words.tr: adj. 易接近的；可使用的；简单易懂的；可进入的；
words.ex: The park is accessible by bus.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园乘公交车可达。
words.en: If a place or building is accessible to people, it is easy for them to reach it or get into it. If an object is accessible, it is easy to reach.

words.tr: adj. 先进的；高级的； v. 提前；前进；“advance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This school uses advanced technology in classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校在教室里使用先进的技术。
words.en: An advanced system, method, or design is modern and has been developed from an earlier version of the same thing.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.ex: He left early, according to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 根据老师的说法，他早早离开了。
words.en: In accordance with or as stated by something.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.ex: It is advantageous to wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 早起是有利的。
words.en: If something is advantageous to you, it is likely to benefit you.

words.tr: v. 解释说明；“account”的现在分词； n. 会计；会计学；
words.ex: He is accounting for his absence.
words.ex_cn: 他正在解释他的缺席。
words.en: Accounting is the process of keeping financial accounts.

words.ex: He saw an advertisement on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他在电视上看到一则广告。
words.en: An advertisement is a notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event or publicizing a job vacancy.

words.tr: n. 广告活动；广告业； v. 做广告；“advertise”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company launched a new advertising campaign last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月推出了一项新的广告活动。
words.en: The activity of producing advertisements for commercial products or services.

words.tr: v. 完成；实现；达到；获得；
words.ex: He worked hard to achieve his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以完成他的目标。
words.en: To achieve something means to reach a particular goal or result through effort, skill, or courage.

words.ex: The advertiser showed a new TV commercial.
words.ex_cn: 广告商播放了一则新的电视广告。
words.en: An advertiser is a person or company that pays for a product, service, or event to be advertised.

words.tr:
prep. 穿过；横过；在…对面；
adv. 横过；穿过；越过；
words.ex: He walked across the street.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过街道。
words.en: From one side to the other of something with clear limits, such as an area of land, a road, or a river.

words.ex: I advise you to eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 我建议你多吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you advise someone to do something, you tell them what you think they should do.

words.tr: 动词短语. 建议某人做某事
words.ex: I advise you to rest now.
words.ex_cn: 我建议你现在休息。
words.en: To recommend or suggest that someone should do something.

words.tr:
v. 行动；表现；演戏；
n. 行动；法令；
words.ex: He acted quickly to save the child.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速行动救了那个孩子。
words.en: To do something for a particular purpose or in a particular way; to behave in a particular way; to have an effect or influence on something; to perform a part in a play, film, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 采取行动；实施措施
words.ex: He takes actions to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 他采取行动保护环境。
words.en: To do something in order to achieve a particular result or to deal with a problem.

words.ex: The government took quick action to fix the problem.
words.ex_cn: 政府迅速采取行动解决问题。
words.en: The fact or process of doing something, typically to achieve an aim.

words.ex: Rain can affect the crop growth.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会影响作物生长。
words.en: To have an influence on or cause a change in someone or something.

words.ex: He is afraid of the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他害怕黑暗。
words.en: Feeling fear or anxiety; frightened.

words.tr: adj. 活跃的；积极的；主动的；
words.ex: He is an active student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上是一个活跃的学生。
words.en: Someone who is active moves around a lot or does a lot of things.

words.tr: phrase. 害怕做某事；不敢做某事
words.ex_cn: 他不敢在课堂上发言。
words.en: If you are afraid to do something, you are frightened to do it or unwilling to do it because you think it might be dangerous or harmful.

words.ex: The school organized a fun activity for the students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生们组织了一场有趣的活动。
words.en: An activity is something that you spend time doing.

words.tr: phrase. 稀有动物；珍稀动物
words.ex: Zoos protect rare animals from extinction.
words.ex_cn: 动物园保护珍稀动物免于灭绝。
words.en: Rare animals refer to species that are not commonly found and are often at risk of extinction due to various factors such as habitat destruction, pollution, and hunting.

words.ex: Wild animals live in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 野生动物生活在森林里。
words.en: Animals that live in a natural, undomesticated state, especially those not tamed or domesticated by humans.

words.ex: He called me again yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天又给我打了电话。
words.en: Once more; another time.

words.tr:
n. 年龄；时代；
v. 变老；
words.ex: His age is 25 years.
words.ex_cn: 他的年龄是25岁。
words.en: The length of time that a person has lived or a thing has existed.

words.tr:
adj. 又一个的；另一个的；
pron. 又一；另一；
words.ex: I need another cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我需要又一杯茶。
words.en: used to refer to an additional person or thing of the same type as one already mentioned or known about.

words.ex: I saw him two days ago.
words.ex_cn: 我两天前见过他。
words.en: If something happened a particular length of time ago, it is that length of time since it happened.

words.tr:
v. 回答；回应；
n. 回答；答案；
words.ex: He answered the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: An answer is something that you say or write when you reply to a question or remark.

words.ex: He answers calls every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上接电话。
words.en: To respond to telephone or communication requests, especially in a professional context.

words.ex: I agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 我同意你的看法。
words.en: If people agree with each other about something, they have the same opinion about it or say that they have the same opinion.

words.ex: Farmers work hard in agriculture.
words.ex_cn: 农民在农业中辛勤工作。
words.en: The science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals to provide food, wool, and other products.

words.ex: He is anti-social and rarely talks to others.
words.ex_cn: 他性格孤僻，很少和别人说话。
words.en: Not liking or avoiding the company of other people.

words.tr: phrase. 反社会行为；不道德或扰乱公共秩序的行为
words.ex: He shows anti-social behavior by avoiding people and shouting for no reason.
words.ex_cn: 他通过避开他人和无理由大喊来表现反社会行为。
words.en: Behavior that is contrary to the norms of society, often causing harm or distress to others.

words.ex: He works on an agricultural farm.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个农场工作。
words.en: Relating to the science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals to provide food, wool, and other products.

words.tr:
n. 帮助；援助；
v. 帮助；协助；
words.ex: The charity provided aid to the flood victims.
words.ex_cn: 慈善机构向洪水受害者提供了帮助。
words.en: To aid someone means to help or assist them. Aid can also refer to the help or support given.

words.tr: 短语动词. 向……提供帮助；援助
words.ex: The charity gives aid to poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善机构向贫困儿童提供援助。
words.en: To provide assistance or support to someone, especially in a time of need.

words.ex: I can't find my keys anywhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在任何地方都找不到我的钥匙。
words.en: in, at, or to any place, when it does not matter where

words.tr: n. 外观；外表；出现；露面；
words.ex: The appearance of the house surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The way that someone or something looks or the act of coming into view.

words.tr:
n. 目标；目的；
v. 瞄准；以其为目标；
words.ex: His aim is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: An aim is a goal or purpose that you are trying to achieve. It can also refer to the act of directing a weapon or other object towards a target.

words.tr: phrase. v. 以某人为目标；针对某人
words.ex: He aims at his brother during the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在游戏中针对他的兄弟。
words.en: To direct one's efforts or intentions toward a specific person or group.

words.tr: phrase. 旨在做某事；打算做某事
words.ex: We aim to help people every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天致力于帮助人们。
words.en: To have the intention of achieving something.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请银行的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 申请一份工作
words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请商店里的一份工作。
words.en: To formally request to be considered for a position of employment.

words.tr: adj. 适当的；合适的；恰当的；
words.ex: This dress is appropriate for a wedding.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子适合参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is appropriate is suitable or acceptable for a particular situation.

words.ex: The air is clean after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后空气很清新。
words.en: Air is the invisible gaseous substance surrounding the earth, a mixture mainly of oxygen and nitrogen.

words.ex: He joined the air force last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年加入了空军。
words.en: The branch of a nation's armed services that conducts military operations in the air.

words.tr: phrase. 航空旅行；乘飞机旅行
words.ex: He likes air travel because it is fast.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢航空旅行，因为它很快。
words.en: The action or activity of traveling by aircraft.

words.ex: The trip takes approximately 30 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这段旅程大约需要30分钟。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is close to the actual, but not completely accurate or exact.

words.ex: The area of the rectangle is 20 square meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形的面积是20平方米。
words.en: An area is a particular part of a place, piece of land, or country.

words.tr: phrase. 在生活的各个方面；在人生各个领域
words.ex: Exercise is important in all areas of life.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼在生活的各个方面都很重要。
words.en: In every aspect or domain of one's existence, from personal to professional.

words.ex: People all over the world like chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 全世界的人都喜欢巧克力。
words.en: everywhere in the world

words.ex: People all around the world celebrate New Year.
words.ex_cn: 世界各地的人们庆祝新年。
words.en: in every part of the world; worldwide

words.tr: phrase. 区域；地区范围；区域性区域
words.ex: The small town is in a regional area far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇位于远离城市的地区。
words.en: A specific geographical area or zone, often with distinct characteristics or governance.

words.ex: Many children live in rural areas far from cities.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子住在远离城市的农村地区。
words.en: Rural areas are regions located outside towns and cities, often characterized by a lower population density and a focus on agricultural activities.

words.ex: Many people live in urban areas.
words.ex_cn: 许多人住在城市地区。
words.en: Urban areas are regions characterized by high population density and vast human features in comparison to areas surrounding them. Urban areas may be cities, towns or conurbations, but the term is not commonly extended to rural settlements such as villages and hamlets.

words.tr: v. 允许；留出；给予；承认；
words.ex: My parents allow me to go out on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母允许我周末外出。
words.en: If someone is allowed to do something, it is all right for them to do it and they will not get into trouble.

words.tr: v. 指出；表明；争论；争辩；
words.ex: He argued that the plan was too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 他指出这个计划太昂贵了。
words.en: If one person argues with another, they speak angrily to each other about something that they disagree about. You can also say that two people argue.

words.tr:
adv. 单独；独自；
adj. 独自的；孤独的；
words.ex: He walked alone in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他独自在公园里散步。
words.en: If you are alone, you are not with any other people.

words.tr: adj. 武装的； v. “arm”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The armed soldiers marched through the town.
words.ex_cn: 武装的士兵穿过城镇。
words.en: Equipped with weapons, especially firearms.

words.tr: phrase. 与...在一起；沿着；除此之外，还…
words.ex: He bought apples along with oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果，还买了橙子。
words.en: in addition to someone or something else; together with someone or something else

words.ex: The army trains new soldiers every month.
words.ex_cn: 军队每个月训练新兵。
words.en: An army is a large organized group of people who are armed and trained to fight on land in a war.

words.ex: He has already finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他已经完成了他的作业。
words.en: You use already to say that something has happened, or that something had happened before the moment you are referring to.

words.ex: He loves to paint and study art.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢绘画和学习艺术。
words.en: Art consists of paintings, sculpture, and other pictures or objects which are created for people to look at and admire or think deeply about.

words.tr: n. 替代选择；替代选择（alternative 的复数）；
words.ex: We need to find better alternatives to plastic.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要找到比塑料更好的替代选择。
words.en: An alternative is something that you can choose to do or use instead of something else.

words.ex: The artist painted a beautiful landscape.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家画了一幅美丽的风景画。
words.en: An artist is someone who draws or paints pictures or creates sculptures as a job or hobby.

words.ex: He always eats breakfast at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他总是在早上七点吃早餐。
words.en: At all times; on all occasions.

words.tr:
adv. 如同；和…一样
prep. 作为；如同
conj. 由于；像；当…时；尽管
words.ex: He runs as fast as a cheetah.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得像猎豹一样快。
words.en: used to compare two things, to show that they are similar in some way; used to introduce the reason for something; used to mean 'in the role of'

words.ex: As for homework, I finished it yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 至于作业，我昨天就完成了。
words.en: used to start talking about someone or something

words.ex: He eats as much as his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他吃得和他兄弟一样多。
words.en: You use 'as much as' to say that something is true to the same extent as something else.

words.ex: His ambition is to become a president.
words.ex_cn: 他的野心是成为总统。
words.en: An ambition is a strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.

words.tr:
n. 数量；数额；
v. 总计；等于；
words.ex: The amount of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: An amount of something is how much there is of it, or how much you have, need, or get.

words.tr: 短语. 大量的，巨大的数量的（用于不可数名词）
words.ex: He has a huge amount of homework to finish.
words.ex_cn: 他有一大堆作业要完成。
words.en: A very large quantity of something.

words.ex: He analyzes data every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天分析数据。
words.en: To examine something methodically and in detail, typically in order to explain and interpret it.

words.ex: One aspect of learning English is practicing speaking.
words.ex_cn: 学习英语的一个方面是练习口语。
words.en: An aspect of something is one of the parts of its character or nature.

words.ex: He asks me a question every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天问我一个问题。
words.en: If you ask someone something, you say something to them in the form of a question because you want to know the answer.

words.ex: The animal is sleeping in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只动物正在森林里睡觉。
words.en: An animal is a living creature such as a dog, lion, or rabbit, rather than a plant, insect, bird, or fish.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.ex: He is watching TV at home.
words.ex_cn: 他正在家里看电视。
words.en: In or at one's own home.

words.tr: v. 出席；参加；注意；照料；
words.ex: He will attend the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会出席会议。
words.en: To be present at an event, meeting, or function; to take care of or look after someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 上大学；就读于一所学院
words.ex: He will attend a college next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将上大学。
words.en: To enroll in and participate in courses at a university or higher education institution.

words.ex: He attends lectures every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都去听讲座。
words.en: Go to classes or talks given by a teacher or expert.

words.ex: He was late because the bus was slow.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车很慢。
words.en: You use 'because' when stating the reason for something.

words.ex: He was late because of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他因为公交车而迟到了。
words.en: You use 'because of' to introduce the reason or explanation for something.

words.ex: The caterpillar becomes a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成蝴蝶。
words.en: To begin to be something or to develop into something.

words.ex: His attitude toward homework is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, which is often reflected in a person's behavior.

words.ex: The child behaves well in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在课堂上表现得很好。
words.en: To behave means to act in a particular way, especially in a way that is good or correct.

words.ex: The bright flowers attract bees.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的花朵吸引蜜蜂。
words.en: If something or someone attracts you, they have particular qualities which cause you to like or admire them.

words.ex: His behaviour at school is very good.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校的行为很好。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.ex: The attraction of the city draws many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: An attraction is something that makes people want to go to a place or do a particular thing because they are interested in it.

words.ex: I believe you are telling the truth.
words.ex_cn: 我相信你在说真话。
words.en: If you believe in something, you think that it is true, or that it exists.

words.tr:
v. 把…归因于；由…引起；
n. 品质；属性；特征；属性；
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.tr: n. 权威；官方机构；权力；权威人士；当局；
words.ex: The teacher is an authority on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师是古代史方面的权威。
words.en: The power to make decisions or enforce rules.

words.tr: n. 当局；官方；权威；“authority”的复数；
words.ex: The authorities closed the park for safety reasons.
words.ex_cn: 当局为了安全原因关闭了公园。
words.en: The people or organizations that are in charge of a particular country or area and have the power to make laws and enforce them.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: Eating vegetables is beneficial to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你的健康有益。
words.en: Promoting or enhancing well-being; advantageous.

words.tr:
n. 平均数；平均水平；
adj. 平均的；普通的；
v. 平均为…；
words.ex: The average of 4, 5, and 6 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 4、5和6的平均数是5。
words.en: An average is the result that you get when you add two or more numbers together and divide the total by the number of numbers you added together.

words.tr:
v. 有益于；有助于；
n. 利益；好处；
words.ex: Exercise benefits your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有益于你的健康。
words.en: A benefit is something that helps you or improves your life in some way.

words.ex: He avoids eating sugar to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他避免吃糖以保持健康。
words.en: If you avoid something, you take action in order to prevent it from happening to you.

words.tr:
adj. 最好的；
adv. 最好地；
n. 最佳物；佼佼者；最高水平；
words.ex: He is the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是队里最好的球员。
words.en: Of the most excellent, effective, or desirable type or quality.

words.ex: He walked away from the house.
words.ex_cn: 他远离了房子。
words.en: If someone or something moves or is moved away from a place, they move or are moved so that they are no longer there.

words.tr: adj. 更好的；更优秀的；“good”的比较级； adv. 更好地；“well”的比较级； v. 胜过；使更佳；
words.ex: This shirt is better than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫比那件更好。
words.en: If something is better, it is of a higher standard, quality, or level than something else, or than it was before.

words.tr: conj. 在…和…之间；在…与…之间
words.ex: The meeting is between 10 and 11.
words.ex_cn: 会议在10点到11点之间。
words.en: Between is used to indicate the relationship of one thing to another, showing that something is in the middle of two points, things, or times.

words.ex: He is a big boy now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在是个大男孩了。
words.en: Of considerable size or extent; larger than other items of its kind.

words.ex: He changed his job because of his background.
words.ex_cn: 他因为自己的背景换了工作。
words.en: The background is the situation that exists at a particular time, or the situation in which something happens, which helps to explain it.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；天平；秤；
v. （使）相抵；（使）平衡；
words.ex: She maintains a good balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休息之间保持良好的平衡。
words.en: Balance is the ability to remain steady when you are standing up. Also, it refers to the state of having your weight spread equally so that you do not fall. In finance, it refers to the amount of money you have in a bank account.

words.w: achieve a balance between A and B
words.tr: 短语. 在A和B之间取得平衡
words.uk: əˈtʃiːv ə ˈbæləns bɪˈtwiːn eɪ ənd biː
words.us: əˈtʃiv ə ˈbæləns bɪˈtwiːn eɪ ənd biː
words.ex: He tries to achieve a balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 他努力在工作和休息之间取得平衡。
words.en: Establish a fair or suitable proportion between two different things.

words.ex: His birth was in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: The emergence of a baby or other young from the body of its mother; the start of life as a physically separate being.

words.ex: Nike is a famous brand.
words.ex_cn: 耐克是一个著名品牌。
words.en: A brand is a name, term, design, symbol, or any other feature that identifies one seller's good or service as distinct from those of other sellers.

words.ex: The scientist made a breakthrough in cancer research.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家在癌症研究中取得了突破。
words.en: A breakthrough is a significant development or achievement that helps to solve a problem or improve a situation.

words.tr:
v. 禁止；
n. 禁止；
words.ex: The school bans phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If there is a ban on something, it is not allowed. If something is banned, it is not allowed to be done, shown, or used.

words.ex: He is broad-minded and accepts different opinions.
words.ex_cn: 他思想开明，接受不同的观点。
words.en: Willing to respect or accept behavior or opinions different from one's own; open to new ideas.

words.ex: I deposited money at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 我到银行存了钱。
words.en: A bank is an institution where people or businesses can keep their money or borrow money. It can also refer to the land alongside a river or lake.

words.tr: adj. 破损的；弄坏的； v. 打破；打断；“break”的过去分词；
words.ex: The broken cup lay on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 破了的杯子躺在地板上。
words.en: Damaged or shattered into pieces, typically as a result of force or impact.

words.tr:
n. 基础；基地；
v. 以…为基础；
words.ex: The base of the building is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的基础非常坚固。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为基础；以…为根据
words.ex: The plan is based on simple rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划是基于简单规则的。
words.en: If something is based on something else, it uses it as the thing from which it develops.

words.ex: This is a basic math skill.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个基本的数学技能。
words.en: You use basic to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or necessary, and on which others depend.

words.ex: The basis of math is numbers.
words.ex_cn: 数学的基础是数字。
words.en: The underlying support or foundation for an idea, argument, or process.

words.ex: She is a beautiful girl.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个美丽的女孩。
words.en: Pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically.

words.ex: Smoking is bad for your lungs.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的肺有害。
words.en: To have a harmful or negative effect on someone or something.

words.ex: Eating vegetables is good for your health.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你的健康有好处。
words.en: To be beneficial or advantageous for someone or something.

words.ex: He is busy with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正忙于做作业。
words.en: To be actively engaged in a task or activity, often to the exclusion of other activities.

words.ex: The builder constructed a new house last month.
words.ex_cn: 这位营造商上个月建造了一栋新房子。
words.en: A builder is a person whose job is to build or repair houses and other buildings.

words.tr: n. 建筑物；楼房； v. 建筑；“build”的现在分词；
words.ex: The tall building has 20 floors.
words.ex_cn: 这栋高楼有20层。
words.en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place.

words.ex: He runs a small business selling bread.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家卖面包的小生意。
words.en: Business refers to the activity of buying and selling goods and services, or a particular company that does this.

words.tr: phrase. 停业；倒闭；不再经营
words.ex: The small shop is out of business.
words.ex_cn: 这家小店已经倒闭了。
words.en: No longer operating as a business; having ceased trading, especially because of financial difficulties.

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.ex: She volunteers at a charitable organization.
words.ex_cn: 她在一家慈善组织做志愿者。
words.en: A charitable organization is a non-profit organization that operates for purposes beneficial to the public or a specific group of people, often focusing on relief of the poor, the distressed, or the underprivileged.

words.tr: phrase. 独自地；单独地；靠自己
words.ex: The children cleaned the room by themselves.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们自己打扫了房间。
words.en: If people do something by themselves, they do it without any help from anyone else.

words.ex: This shirt is cheap and nice.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫又便宜又好看。
words.en: If something is cheap, it costs less money than usual or than you expected.

words.ex: He is chiefly interested in science.
words.ex_cn: 他主要对科学感兴趣。
words.en: used to indicate that something is true to a great extent, or primarily

words.ex: The child is playing with toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个儿童正在玩玩具。
words.en: A child is a human being who is not yet an adult.

words.ex: The children are playing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在公园里玩耍。
words.en: Children are people who are not yet adults, typically those who are under the age of 18.

words.ex: The country is fighting against child labour.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在打击童工。
words.en: The use of children in work that is harmful to their physical or mental development, often in violation of legal standards and ethical norms.

words.tr: phrase. 照料；关怀；喜欢；想要
words.ex: She cares for her sick mother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她生病的母亲。
words.en: To like or love someone or something; to look after someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 儿童保育；照顾孩子
words.ex: She decided to stay at home to provide child care for her baby.
words.ex_cn: 她决定留在家里为她的宝宝提供儿童保育。
words.en: The care of children, especially by a person or organization while the parents are at work or absent.

words.ex: He built a successful career in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学领域建立了成功的事业。
words.en: A career is the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money.

words.ex: He carries a bag to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带一个包去学校。
words.en: To carry something means to move it while supporting it, especially in your hands or arms.

words.ex: It is illegal to carry guns in this country without a proper license.
words.ex_cn: 在这个国家，没有适当的许可证携带枪支是违法的。
words.en: To carry guns means to have guns with you, usually in a concealed or open manner, often implying the potential for use.

words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.ex: He made a choice to study hard.
words.ex_cn: 他选择努力学习。
words.en: If you have a choice, you can choose between two or more things.

words.ex: He chooses coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都选择喝咖啡。
words.en: To choose means to select someone or something from a group of possibilities.

words.ex: He smokes a cigar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后抽一支雪茄。
words.en: A cigar is a tightly rolled bundle of dried and fermented tobacco leaves, which is ignited so that its smoke may be drawn into the mouth.

words.tr: n. 情况；事例；案件；外壳；容器（箱，盒）；
words.ex: In this case, we should wait longer.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们应该再等一会儿。
words.en: A particular situation or example of something.

words.ex: Under these circumstances, we had to cancel the trip.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们不得不取消旅行。
words.en: A circumstance is a fact or event that makes a situation the way it is.

words.tr:
v. 导致；引起；
n. 原因；理由；事业；
words.ex: Smoking can cause lung disease.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会导致肺癌。
words.en: The cause of something is what makes it happen or exist.

words.ex: He lives in a big city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个大城市里。
words.en: A city is a large town where many people live and work.

words.ex: Many cities have busy streets and tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 许多城市都有繁忙的街道和高楼。
words.en: A city is a large town.

words.ex: The celebrity smiled at the fans outside the theater.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人向剧院外的粉丝微笑。
words.en: A celebrity is a famous person, especially in entertainment or sports.

words.ex: Every citizen must follow the law.
words.ex_cn: 每个公民都必须遵守法律。
words.en: A citizen is a person who is legally recognized as a member of a country or state, either by birth or by naturalization, and who is entitled to its protection and privileges.

words.ex: The park is at the center of the city.
words.ex_cn: 公园位于城市的中心。
words.en: The middle point or part of something; to place something in the middle of an area.

words.tr: v. 使开化；使文明；教化
words.ex: They tried to civilize the wild tribe.
words.ex_cn: 他们试图使这个原始部落文明化。
words.en: To civilize means to bring a place or people to a stage of social, cultural, and moral development considered to be more advanced.

words.tr: phrase. 儿童中心；为儿童提供活动、教育或照护服务的场所
words.ex: The children centre gives kids a safe place to play.
words.ex_cn: 儿童中心为孩子们提供了一个安全的玩耍场所。
words.en: A place where young children are cared for and educated.

words.tr:
v. 声称；索赔；
n. 声称；索要；
words.ex: He claims that he saw a UFO last night.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己昨晚看到了不明飞行物。
words.en: If you say that someone claims that something is true, you mean they say that it is true but you are not sure whether or not they are telling the truth.

words.tr: phrase. 打扫干净；收拾整洁
words.ex: They clean up the room every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每星期六打扫房间。
words.en: To make a place or thing clean and tidy by removing dirt, rubbish, or unwanted items.

words.ex: The first century had no computers.
words.ex_cn: 第一个世纪没有电脑。
words.en: A century is a period of one hundred years.

words.ex: The building has stood for centuries.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑已经屹立了几个世纪。
words.en: A century is a period of one hundred years. Centuries are used as a way to divide up the timeline of history into manageable sections.

words.tr: adj. 某个；确定的；一定的；一定程度上的；
words.ex: I saw a certain man near the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园附近看到某个男人。
words.en: If you are certain about something, you have no doubt about it.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.tr:
adj. 接近的；亲密的；
adv. 紧挨地；接近地；
v. 关闭；
words.ex: They are close friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们是亲密的朋友。
words.en: To move so as to bar passage through something; to shut.

words.tr:
n. 变化；变革；
v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: There was a big change in the weather.
words.ex_cn: 天气发生了很大的变化。
words.en: To make or become different; to alter or modify; to exchange or replace something with another.

words.tr: phrase. 换工作；更换职业岗位
words.ex: He wants to change jobs next month.
words.ex_cn: 他想下个月换工作。
words.en: To leave one's job and start doing another one.

words.ex: He wants to change career and become a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他想换职业，成为一名老师。
words.en: Switch from one profession or job to another.

words.ex: He watched the game closely.
words.ex_cn: 他紧密地观看了比赛。
words.en: In a way that is very near in space or time; with little or no space or time in between.

words.ex: He hangs his clothes on the line to dry.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服挂在绳子上晾干。
words.en: Clothes are the things that people wear, such as shirts, coats, trousers, and dresses.

words.tr:
n. 海峡；渠道；河床；频道；
v. 引导；
words.ex: The English Channel separates England from France.
words.ex_cn: 英吉利海峡将英格兰与法国分隔开。
words.en: A channel is a television station and the programs that it broadcasts. A channel is also a method or system that people use to send information, goods, etc. to each other.

words.ex: He bought new clothing for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 他为冬天买了新衣服。
words.en: Clothing refers to items worn on the body. Clothing is typically made of fabrics or textiles but over time has included garments made from animal skin or other thin sheets of materials put together.

words.tr: n. 性格；人物角色；特点；
words.ex: His character is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的性格善良且有耐心。
words.en: The combination of qualities or features that distinguishes one person, group, or thing from another.

words.ex: He burns coal to keep his house warm.
words.ex_cn: 他烧煤来让房子暖和。
words.en: Coal is a hard black substance that is extracted from the ground and burned as fuel.

words.tr:
n. 特点；特性；
adj. 典型的；特有的；
words.ex: Honesty is a key characteristic of a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一个好朋友的关键特点。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.ex: He collects stamps every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周收集邮票。
words.en: If you collect a number of things, you gather them together, usually because you want them for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 收集点；集合点；采集点
words.ex: The school has set up a collection point for used books.
words.ex_cn: 学校设立了一个旧书收集点。
words.en: A place where items are gathered or accumulated for a specific purpose.

words.tr:
n. 收费；负责；指控；
v. 收费；充电；
words.ex: The hotel charge is $50 per night.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的收费是每晚50美元。
words.en: If you charge someone, you ask them to pay an amount of money for something that you have sold to them or done for them.

words.ex: The school charges fees for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 学校对午餐收费。
words.en: Ask for payment for services provided.

words.ex: The library gives books free of charge.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆免费提供书籍。
words.en: If something is free of charge, it does not cost anything.

words.ex: He works at a small college.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所小型学院工作。
words.en: A college is an institution where students study after they have left school, in order to get a degree or qualification.

words.ex: The teacher showed a chart of temperatures.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一张温度图表。
words.en: A chart is a graphical representation of data, in which the data is represented by symbols, such as bars in a bar chart, lines in a line chart, or slices in a pie chart.

words.ex: The bar chart shows the number of students in each class.
words.ex_cn: 条形图显示了每个班级的学生人数。
words.en: A bar chart is a type of chart that presents categorical data with rectangular bars with heights or lengths proportional to the values that they represent.

words.ex: He drew a flow chart to show the steps.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个流程图来展示步骤。
words.en: A flow chart is a diagram that represents a process or algorithm, showing the steps as boxes of various kinds, and their order by connecting them with arrows.

words.tr: phrase. 饼形图；圆形分格统计图表
words.ex: The pie chart shows the percentage of students who like different fruits.
words.ex_cn: 饼状图显示了喜欢不同水果的学生的百分比。
words.en: A pie chart is a circular statistical graphic which is divided into slices to illustrate numerical proportion.

words.tr:
n. 连环漫画；
adj. 滑稽的；
words.ex: He reads a comic every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读一本连环漫画。
words.en: A comic is someone who entertains people by making them laugh, especially a professional comedian.

words.tr:
v. 评论；表达意见；
n. 评论；意见；
words.ex: He commented on the movie last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚对这部电影发表了评论。
words.en: A comment is something that you say which expresses your opinion of something or which gives an explanation of it.

words.ex: Some people commit crimes because they are poor.
words.ex_cn: 有些人因为贫穷而犯罪。
words.en: To perform illegal activities or actions that are punishable by law.

words.ex: He commonly eats breakfast at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他一般在早上七点吃早餐。
words.en: If something is commonly the case, it is usually or often the case.

words.ex: They communicate well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此沟通得很好。
words.en: To communicate means to share or exchange information, news, or ideas, especially by speaking or writing.

words.ex: Good communication helps people understand each other.
words.ex_cn: 良好的交流有助于人们相互理解。
words.en: The imparting or exchanging of information by speaking, writing, or using some other medium.

words.ex: The consumer buys food at the store.
words.ex_cn: 消费者在商店购买食物。
words.en: A consumer is a person who buys goods or uses services.

words.ex: He buys consumer goods every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都购买消费品。
words.en: Goods that are bought and used by consumers, rather than by manufacturers for producing other goods.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.ex: The communities near the park hold weekly meetings.
words.ex_cn: 公园附近的社区每周举行会议。
words.en: Communities are groups of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.ex: The consumption of water has increased this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年水的消耗量增加了。
words.en: Consumption is the act of buying and using products.

words.ex: He compare apples and oranges to see which is sweeter.
words.ex_cn: 他比较苹果和橙子，看看哪个更甜。
words.en: If you compare one thing with another, you consider the similarities and differences between them.

words.tr: phrase. 把……比作……；与……相比较（通常用于不同类事物之间的比喻或类比）
words.ex: He compared her smile to the sun.
words.ex_cn: 他把她的微笑比作太阳。
words.en: If you compare something to something else, you say that they are similar in some way.

words.ex: Two companies compete for the same customers.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司为争夺相同的客户而竞争。
words.en: If you compete with someone for something, you try to get it for yourself and stop the other person getting it. You can also say that two people compete for something that they both want.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.ex: The competitiveness of this company comes from its low prices.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的竞争性来自于它的低价。
words.en: Competitiveness refers to the ability of a company, country, or individual to compete effectively with others in a particular market or activity.

words.ex: He beat his competitor in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中击败了对手。
words.en: A competitor is a person, team, or company that is competing against others, especially in business or sports.

words.tr:
adj. 完整的；完成的；
v. 完成；
words.ex: The book is complete with all chapters.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有所有章节，是完整的。
words.en: If you complete something, you finish doing, making, or producing it.

words.ex: He completely forgot his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他完全忘记了钥匙。
words.en: In a way that is whole or entire; to the fullest extent.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.tr: v. 贡献；促成；捐献；投稿；
words.ex: He contributes money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他向慈善机构捐款。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.tr: phrase. 贡献；促成；导致；有助于
words.ex: Volunteers contribute to the clean-up of the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者们为公园的清洁做出了贡献。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.tr: phrase. 对……做出贡献；为……作出贡献；有助于……
words.ex: Many scientists make contributions to the development of new medicines.
words.ex_cn: 许多科学家为新药的研发做出了贡献。
words.en: To give or supply in common with others; give to a common fund or for a common purpose.

words.ex: He uses compost to make his garden soil richer.
words.ex_cn: 他用堆肥来使花园的土壤更肥沃。
words.en: Compost is a mixture of decaying organic matter, such as leaves and food scraps, used to improve soil structure and provide nutrients for plants.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet is compulsory for cyclists.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是必须的。
words.en: If something is compulsory, you must do it because of a rule or law.

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.ex: This store is convenient for buying groceries.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店买杂货很方便。
words.en: If something is convenient, it is easy to use or do, or it is useful and suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He uses a computer to do his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算机做作业。
words.en: A computer is an electronic machine that can store and deal with large amounts of information.

words.ex: He is learning computer programming at school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学校学习计算机编程。
words.en: The process of designing and building an executable computer program to accomplish a specific computing result or to perform a specific task.

words.ex: He conveyed his thanks with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着表达了谢意。
words.en: If you convey information or a message, you communicate it to someone, often in a way that is not direct.

words.tr:
adj. 凉爽的；酷的；凉的；顶好的；
v. 变凉；
words.ex: The water is cool after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后水很凉爽。
words.en: If you say that a person or their behavior is cool, you mean that they are calm and unemotional, especially in a difficult situation.

words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you concentrate on something, you give it your full attention and think about it carefully.

words.ex: They cooperate to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他们合作以按时完成项目。
words.en: If you cooperate with someone, you work with them or help them for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The two companies showed good cooperation on the project.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司在这个项目上表现出良好的合作。
words.en: Cooperation is the process of working or acting together, which can be seen in many aspects of life, including business, science, and social interactions.

words.tr:
n. 副本；(书，报纸等的) 一本；复制品；
v. 复制；
words.ex: Please give me a copy of the report.
words.ex_cn: 请给我一份报告的副本。
words.en: A copy is a thing made to be similar or identical to another. As a verb, to copy means to make a similar or identical version of something.

words.ex: His condition improved after the treatment.
words.ex_cn: 他的状况在接受治疗后好转了。
words.en: A condition is a state of affairs that must exist or be brought about before something else can happen or be done.

words.ex: The conflict between the two countries lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家之间的冲突持续了多年。
words.en: A conflict is a serious disagreement or argument, typically a protracted one.

words.tr:
adj. 正确的；
v. 改正；修正；
words.ex: The answer is correct.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案是正确的。
words.en: If something is correct, it is right and true. If you correct someone, you tell them that they are wrong.

words.ex: Traffic congestion caused delays on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 交通堵塞导致了高速公路的延误。
words.en: Congestion refers to the state of being overcrowded, especially with traffic or people, or the condition of being blocked or clogged.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 支付费用；承担成本
words.ex: He works hard to cover the cost of his books.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作来支付书本的费用。
words.en: To pay for something, especially when the amount is large or unexpected.

words.ex: The connection between the two wires is loose.
words.ex_cn: 两根电线之间的连接松了。
words.en: A connection is a relationship between two things, people, or groups.

words.tr: 短语动词. 没有联系；无关联
words.ex: He has no connection to the company.
words.ex_cn: 他和这家公司没有任何关系。
words.en: Have no relationship or link with something or someone.

words.ex: He loves his country and wants to serve it.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱自己的国家，想要为它服务。
words.en: A country is a region identified as a distinct entity in political geography.

words.ex: Many countries have beautiful beaches.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家有美丽的海滩。
words.en: A country is a nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.

words.ex: The host country provided excellent facilities for the athletes.
words.ex_cn: 东道国为运动员提供了极好的设施。
words.en: The country where an event, especially a sports event or a conference, takes place.

words.ex: Lying has serious consequences.
words.ex_cn: 撒谎会有严重的后果。
words.en: A consequence is a result or effect of an action or condition.

words.ex: He lives in a small county in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他住在乡村的一个小郡里。
words.en: A county is a region of a country used for administrative or other purposes in certain modern nations.

words.tr: n. 县（英国的行政区划）
words.ex: The counties are holding elections this month.
words.ex_cn: 这些县这个月正在举行选举。
words.en: Counties are administrative divisions of a country, especially in the UK, used for local government purposes.

words.ex: I consider going to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我考虑明天去公园。
words.en: If you consider something, you think about it carefully.

words.ex: Please take the weather into account when you plan the trip.
words.ex_cn: 计划旅行时请考虑天气因素。
words.en: To consider something when making a decision or judgment.

words.tr: phrase. 将某事纳入考虑；顾及某事
words.ex: Please take my opinion into consideration.
words.ex_cn: 请考虑我的意见。
words.en: Think about or include something when making a decision.

words.ex: He grew up in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他是在农村长大的。
words.en: The countryside refers to the land and scenery of a rural area, often characterized by farms, fields, and small villages, away from urban centers.

words.ex: The course of the river changed after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流程在洪水后发生了变化。
words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.tr: phrase. 课外课程；课外活动课程
words.ex: He takes extra-curricular courses after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后上课外课程。
words.en: Activities or subjects pursued outside the main school curriculum.

words.tr: phrase. 儿童培训课程；针对儿童开设的技能或知识培训课程
words.ex: The school offers child training courses on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校在周末提供儿童培训课程。
words.en: Classes or programs designed to teach or improve skills in children.

words.tr:
v. 建造；构造；
n. 概念；
words.ex: They construct houses with bricks.
words.ex_cn: 他们用砖块建造房屋。
words.en: To construct something means to build or create it, usually something large such as a building, road, or machine.

words.ex: He creates beautiful paintings with colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用色彩创造美丽的画作。
words.en: To create means to bring something into existence or to cause something to happen as a result of one's actions.

words.ex: The painting is a beautiful creation of the artist.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是艺术家的一个美丽作品。
words.en: The act or process of bringing something into existence.

words.ex: He is a creative boy who draws nice pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有创造力的男孩，会画漂亮的画。
words.en: Someone who is creative has the ability to invent and develop original ideas, especially in the arts.

words.tr: adv. 创造性地；有创造力地；
words.ex: She painted creatively using only her fingers.
words.ex_cn: 她用手指创造性地绘画。
words.en: In a way that involves the use of imagination or original ideas to create something.

words.ex: Children show great creativity when drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在画画时表现出很强的创造力。
words.en: Creativity is the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, or think of new solutions to problems.

words.ex: The police caught the man for a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了那个犯下严重罪行的人。
words.en: A crime is an illegal action or activity for which a person can be punished by law.

words.tr: phrase. 减少犯罪；降低犯罪率
words.ex: The government plans to reduce crime by increasing police presence.
words.ex_cn: 政府计划通过增加警力来减少犯罪。
words.en: To decrease the occurrence of criminal activities.

words.tr:
adj. 犯罪的；
n. 罪犯；
words.ex: He made a criminal mistake by stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他偷钱犯了一个犯罪的错误。
words.en: A criminal is a person who has committed a crime.

words.ex: He has criminal records from his youth.
words.ex_cn: 他年轻时有犯罪记录。
words.en: A criminal record is an official record of a person's criminal history.

words.ex: He received criticism for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到而受到批评。
words.en: Criticism is the act of expressing disapproval of someone or something and of the faults they have or the mistakes they have made.

words.ex: He often criticizes his brother for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他经常批评他弟弟迟到。
words.en: If you criticize someone or something, you express your disapproval of them by saying what you think is wrong with them.

words.ex: The cruel king punished the innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 残酷的国王惩罚了无辜的人。
words.en: Someone who is cruel deliberately causes pain or distress to others or feels no concern about it.

words.ex: They learned about cultural traditions during the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在旅行中了解了文化传统。
words.en: Relating to the ideas, customs, and social behavior of a society.

words.ex: I love learning about different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。
words.en: The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society.

words.ex: He drank water from a cup.
words.ex_cn: 他从杯子里喝水。
words.en: A cup is a small round container that you drink from. Cups usually have handles and are made from china or plastic.

words.ex: In this village, it is a custom to light lanterns during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村庄，节日期间点灯笼是一种习俗。
words.en: A custom is an activity, a way of behaving, or an event which is usual or traditional in a particular society or in particular circumstances.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.ex: The cyclist rides his bike every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位骑自行车的人每天早上骑车。
words.en: A cyclist is someone who rides a bicycle.

words.tr:
adj. 每天的；每日的；
adv. 每天；每日；
n. 日报；
words.ex: He drinks water daily.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝水。
words.en: Something that happens or is done daily happens or is done every day.

words.tr: phrase. 日常生活；每日的生活
words.ex: He uses math in his daily life.
words.ex_cn: 他在日常生活中使用数学。
words.en: The routine activities that a person does every day.

words.tr:
n. 损害；破损；
v. 损害；破坏；
words.ex: The storm caused serious damage to the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴对房屋造成了严重损害。
words.en: Damage is physical harm that is caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful, or valuable.

words.ex: Smoking can damage one's health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会损害健康。
words.en: To cause harm to someone's physical condition.

words.tr: adj. 有害的；造成破坏的； v. 损害；“damage”的现在分词；
words.ex: Smoking is damaging to your lungs.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的肺有害。
words.en: Causing or capable of causing damage; harmful.

words.ex: There is danger near the river.
words.ex_cn: 河边有危险。
words.en: Danger is the possibility that someone may be harmed or killed.

words.ex: The river is dangerous for children.
words.ex_cn: 这条河对孩子来说很危险。
words.en: If something is dangerous, it is able or likely to hurt or harm you.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.tr:
n. 日期；年代；约会；枣子；枣椰树；
v. 标日期；约会；追溯到；过时；
words.ex: What is the date today?
words.ex_cn: 今天是几号？
words.en: A date is a specific day of the month or year, which can be identified by a particular name or number.

words.ex: He decides to go home early.
words.ex_cn: 他决定早点回家。
words.en: If you decide to do something, you choose to do it, usually after you have thought carefully about the other possibilities.

words.ex: He made a quick decision to leave.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速做出了离开的决定。
words.en: A decision is a choice that you make about something after thinking about it.

words.ex: He makes decisions every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天做决定。
words.en: To make a choice or judgment about something after considering the possible options.

words.tr:
n. 下降；衰退；
v. 下降；衰退；
words.ex: There was a sharp decline in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅下降。
words.en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.tr:
n. 减少；
v. 减少；降低；
words.ex: There was a decrease in rainfall last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月降雨量减少了。
words.en: If something decreases or you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

words.ex: The soldiers defend their country from enemies.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们保卫自己的国家免受敌人入侵。
words.en: To defend means to protect someone or something from attack, harm, or criticism. It can also involve arguing in support of someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 需求；要求；
v. 要求；需求；
words.ex: The demand for clean water is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水的需求正在增加。
words.en: If you demand something, you ask for it very forcefully, often because you think you have a right to do so.

words.tr: phrase. 满足需求；符合要求
words.ex: The factory works hard to meet demands.
words.ex_cn: 工厂努力满足需求。
words.en: To satisfy the requirements or needs of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 满足需求；符合需要
words.ex: This program meets the needs of students.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目满足了学生的需求。
words.en: To fulfill or satisfy the requirements or desires of someone or something.

words.ex: Children depend on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you say that one thing depends on another, you mean that the first thing will be affected or determined by the second.

words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.tr:
adj. 依靠的；依赖的；
n. 受赡养者；
words.ex: The child is dependent on his parents for food.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子依靠父母提供食物。
words.en: A dependent person or thing is one that needs the support of another person or thing in order to exist or be successful.

words.ex: The storm deprived us of electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴剥夺了我们的电力。
words.en: If you deprive someone of something that they want or need, you take it away from them, or you prevent them from having it.

words.tr: phrase. 剥夺某人某物；使某人失去某物
words.ex: They can't deprive him of his job.
words.ex_cn: 他们不能剥夺他的工作。
words.en: If you deprive someone of something, you take it away from them or prevent them from having it.

words.ex: The teacher gave a clear description of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师对实验做了清晰的描述。
words.en: A description of someone or something is a statement that explains what they are or what they are like.

words.ex: The teacher gave a descriptive answer about the painting.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这幅画给出了一个描述性的回答。
words.en: If you describe something as descriptive, you mean that it gives a detailed account of something.

words.tr:
n. 设计；图案；花样；企图；图谋；
v. 设计；计划；谋划；构思；
words.ex: The dress has a beautiful design.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子有一个美丽的设计。
words.en: To design something means to plan and make a detailed drawing of it, or to plan and create something in a skillful or artistic way.

words.ex: The storm destroyed the old bridge.
words.ex_cn: 风暴摧毁了那座旧桥。
words.en: To destroy something means to cause so much damage to it that it is completely ruined or does not exist any more.

words.ex: He noticed every detail of the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了这幅画的每一个细节。
words.en: A detail is a small individual feature or element of something.

words.ex: His determination helped him finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他的决心帮助他完成了比赛。
words.en: Determination is the quality that you show when you have decided to do something and you will not let anything stop you.

words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: To develop means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.ex: The country wants to develop economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家想要发展经济。
words.en: Improve the economic condition and growth of a country or region.

words.tr: phrase. 发达国家；指经济、科技和社会发展水平较高的国家
words.ex: Japan is a developed country.
words.ex_cn: 日本是一个发达国家。
words.en: A developed country is a sovereign state that has a high quality of life, developed economy, and advanced technological infrastructure relative to other less industrialized nations.

words.ex: The developing country is building new schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个发展中国家正在建设新的学校。
words.en: A developing country is a country with a less developed industrial base and a low Human Development Index (HDI) relative to other countries.

words.ex: The development of the town took many years.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的发展花了许多年。
words.en: Development is the process of growth, progress, or making something more advanced.

words.ex: He has diabetes and must check his blood every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有糖尿病，必须每天检查血糖。
words.en: A medical condition in which the body cannot produce enough insulin or cannot use insulin properly, leading to high levels of sugar in the blood.

words.ex: The teacher drew a diagram to explain the water cycle.
words.ex_cn: 老师画了一个图表来解释水循环。
words.en: A diagram is a simple drawing which consists mainly of lines and is used, for example, to explain how a machine works.

words.tr:
n. 日常饮食；节食；
v. 节制饮食；
words.ex: His diet includes lots of vegetables and fruits.
words.ex_cn: 他的日常饮食包括大量蔬菜和水果。
words.en: The food and drink usually consumed by a person or group; a special course of food to which one restricts oneself, either to lose weight or for medical reasons.

words.ex: Many old traditions die out over time.
words.ex_cn: 许多古老的传统随着时间推移而消失。
words.en: If something dies out, it becomes less and less common and eventually disappears completely.

words.ex: This color differs from that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色和那个不同。
words.en: If two or more things differ, they are unlike each other in some way.

words.ex: There is a big difference between apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果和橙子之间有很大的差异。
words.en: A difference is a way in which two or more things are not the same.

words.tr: phrase. 要紧；区别对待；有影响；起（重要）作用
words.ex: Volunteering can make a difference in your community.
words.ex_cn: 志愿服务能为你的社区带来改变。
words.en: If something makes a difference, it affects someone or something positively, especially in a noticeable or important way.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎没有影响；几乎不起作用；差别不大
words.ex: It makes little difference if you arrive early or late.
words.ex_cn: 你早到或晚到没什么区别。
words.en: To have a minimal or negligible effect on something.

words.ex: The two apples are different.
words.ex_cn: 这两个苹果不一样。
words.en: not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature, form, or quality

words.ex: This math problem is difficult.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很难。
words.en: Something that is difficult is not easy to do, understand, or deal with.

words.ex: He walked directly to the school.
words.ex_cn: 他直接走向学校。
words.en: If you do something directly, you do it without any delay or without involving anyone else.

words.ex: The director of the school gave a speech.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主任发表了一次演讲。
words.en: A director is a person who is in charge of something, especially a film, play, or organization.

words.ex: I looked up the word in a dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在词典里查了这个词。
words.en: A dictionary is a book in which the words of a language are listed alphabetically, together with their meanings, pronunciations, and other information.

words.ex: The old tree died last winter.
words.ex_cn: 那棵老树去年冬天死了。
words.en: To die means to stop living and become dead.

words.ex: He faced difficulty in solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决这道数学题时遇到了困难。
words.en: A difficulty is a problem or issue that is hard to deal with or understand.

words.ex: The disadvantage of living far away is long commute time.
words.ex_cn: 住得远的劣势是通勤时间长。
words.en: A disadvantage is a factor which makes someone or something less useful, acceptable, or successful than other people or things.

words.tr: adj. 处于不利地位的；贫困的； v. “disadvantage”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The school helps disadvantaged children with free meals.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校为处境不利的孩子提供免费餐食。
words.en: People who are disadvantaged do not have the same opportunities or advantages as other people, often because of their financial situation or social position.

words.ex: I disagree with your opinion.
words.ex_cn: 我不同意你的观点。
words.en: If you disagree with someone or disagree with what they say, you do not accept that what they say is true or you do not accept that it is the correct thing to do.

words.ex: The cat disappeared behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫从房子后面消失了。
words.en: If someone or something disappears, they go away or are taken away so that you cannot see them any more.

words.ex: The earthquake caused a big disaster.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了一场大灾难。
words.en: A disaster is an unexpected event causing great damage, destruction, or distress.

words.tr: phrase. 火灾灾难；由火灾引起的严重灾害
words.ex: The fire disaster destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场火灾灾难摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A fire disaster refers to a catastrophic event involving uncontrolled fire that causes significant damage, destruction, and potentially loss of life.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.ex: Don't discourage him from trying.
words.ex_cn: 不要阻止他尝试。
words.en: If someone or something discourages you, they cause you to lose your enthusiasm about your actions.

words.ex: He discovered a new planet last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年发现了一颗新行星。
words.en: If you discover something that you did not know about before, you become aware of it or find it.

words.ex: We will discuss the homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天讨论作业。
words.en: To discuss something means to talk about it with someone and tell each other your ideas or opinions.

words.ex: He noticed the discrimination between the two prices.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了两个价格之间的区别。
words.en: The unjust or prejudicial treatment of different categories of people, especially on the grounds of race, age, or sex.

words.tr:
n. 展示；陈列；
v. 展示；陈列；
words.ex: The store has a big display of new phones.
words.ex_cn: 商店里有一个新手机的展示。
words.en: To display something means to put it in a place where people can see it easily, or to show it to people.

words.ex: He disposed of the old books.
words.ex_cn: 他处理了那些旧书。
words.en: To dispose of something means to get rid of it, especially by throwing it away.

words.ex: The distance between the two towns is 10 kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 两个城镇之间的距离是10公里。
words.en: The amount of space between two places or things.

words.ex: He is doing distance-learning from home.
words.ex_cn: 他正在家进行远程学习。
words.en: Distance-learning is a method of studying where students do not need to be physically present in a classroom, but instead learn through online courses, video lectures, and other digital resources.

words.tr: phrase. 远程学习项目；通过网络或其他远程方式提供的教育课程
words.ex: He joins distance-learning programs to study at home.
words.ex_cn: 他参加远程学习课程在家学习。
words.en: Online educational courses that allow students to study remotely, often using digital platforms and virtual classrooms.

words.tr: n. 区别；区分；优等评分；
words.ex: There is a clear distinction between right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 对与错之间有明显的区别。
words.en: A distinction is a difference or contrast between similar things or people.

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.tr:
n. 疑问；疑惑；
v. 怀疑；拿不准；
words.ex: I have doubt about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我对这个答案有疑问。
words.en: If you have doubt or doubts about something, you feel uncertain about it and do not know whether it is true or possible. If you say that something is beyond doubt, you mean that it is definitely true.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.tr: adv. 急剧地；引人注目地；
words.ex: The temperature dropped dramatically overnight.
words.ex_cn: 夜间温度急剧下降。
words.en: In a way that is sudden, noticeable, or significant, often in a way that is intended to produce a strong effect.

words.ex: I draw money from the bank every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周从银行提取钱。
words.en: To make a picture, pattern, or diagram by making lines and marks, especially with a pen or pencil, on paper.

words.ex: The drawback of this phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的缺点是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A drawback is a feature of something that makes it less useful or desirable than it could be.

words.tr:
n. 梦；梦想；
v. 梦想；做梦；
words.ex: I had a strange dream last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚做了一个奇怪的梦。
words.en: A dream is a series of thoughts, images, and sensations occurring in a person's mind during sleep. It can also refer to a cherished aspiration, ambition, or ideal.

words.ex: I dream to travel the world one day.
words.ex_cn: 我梦想有一天能环游世界。
words.en: To aspire or aim to achieve something, typically a personal or professional goal.

words.tr:
v. 驾驶；驱使；
n. 动力；
words.ex: He drives a car to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车去上班。
words.en: To operate and control the direction and speed of a motor vehicle; to push, propel, or carry along forcibly or strongly.

words.tr: phrase. 驾驶违规行为；交通违法行为
words.ex: He got a ticket for a driving offense.
words.ex_cn: 他因交通违章收到了一张罚单。
words.en: A violation of traffic laws, such as speeding or illegal parking, that can result in fines or penalties.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed a drug for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他开了一种治疗头痛的药物。
words.en: A drug is a substance which is used to treat an illness, relieve a symptom, or modify a chemical process in the body for a specific purpose.

words.ex: He slept during the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在看电影时睡着了。
words.en: Throughout the course or duration of (a period of time).

words.ex: It is your duty to finish your homework.
words.ex_cn: 完成你的作业是你的职责。
words.en: A duty is a task or action that someone is required to perform.

words.tr:
adj. 每个的；各自的；
pron. 每个；各自；
words.ex: Each student has a book.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都有一本书。
words.en: Used to refer to every one of a group or series considered individually.

words.ex: They help each other with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他们互相帮助做作业。
words.en: You use each other when you are saying that each member of a group does something to or for the other members.

words.ex: He hurt his ear while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了耳朵。
words.en: The organ of hearing in humans and other vertebrates, especially the external part of this organ.

words.ex: He works hard to earn money.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以赚取收入。
words.en: To earn means to gain something, especially money or respect, through your own efforts or work.

words.ex: The earth goes around the sun.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕太阳运转。
words.en: The planet on which we live; the land surface of the world as distinct from the sea or the air.

words.tr:
n. 安逸；轻松；
v. 缓解；减轻；
words.ex: He enjoys the ease of living in a quiet village.
words.ex_cn: 他享受住在安静村庄里的安逸。
words.en: If you talk about the ease of a particular activity, you are referring to the way that it has been made easier to do, or to the fact that it is already easy to do. Ease is also a state of being comfortable and without worry or anxiety.

words.ex: This math problem is easy.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很容易。
words.en: If a job or action is easy, you can do it without difficulty because it is not complicated and causes no problems.

words.ex: He reads an e-book on his tablet.
words.ex_cn: 他用平板电脑读电子书。
words.en: An e-book is a book that is published in digital form and can be read on a computer or other electronic devices.

words.ex: The economic situation is getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 经济状况正在恶化。
words.en: Economic means concerned with the organization of the money, industry, and trade of a country, region, or society.

words.tr: adv. 跟经济有关地；经济地；
words.ex: The country is developing economically.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在经济上发展。
words.en: In a way that relates to economics or finance; in a way that uses no more of something than is necessary.

words.ex: The country's economy is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的经济正在快速增长。
words.en: The economy of a country or region is the system by which money, industry, and trade are organized.

words.ex: They want to educate their children well.
words.ex_cn: 他们想好好教育自己的孩子。
words.en: To educate someone means to teach them over a period of time at a school, college, or university.

words.ex: He values education very much.
words.ex_cn: 他非常重视教育。
words.en: Education is the process of teaching and learning, especially in a school or college, or the knowledge that you get from this.

words.tr: n. 影响；作用；效果；效应；
words.ex: The new law had a big effect on traffic.
words.ex_cn: 新法律对交通产生了很大影响。
words.en: A change that is a result or consequence of an action or other cause.

words.ex: She completed the task effectively.
words.ex_cn: 她有效地完成了任务。
words.en: In a way that produces the intended result or a successful outcome.

words.ex: He works efficiently to finish his tasks.
words.ex_cn: 他高效地完成任务。
words.en: If you do something efficiently, you do it in a way that wastes no time, money, or energy.

words.ex: He made a big effort to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他努力完成这个项目，按时交工。
words.en: If you make an effort to do something, you try hard to do it.

words.tr: conj. 要么…要么…，不是…就是…
words.ex: You can either walk or take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 你可以走路，或者坐公交车。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.ex: The elderly man walks slowly with a cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位年老的男子拄着拐杖慢慢走。
words.en: An elderly person is someone who is old or aging.

words.ex: The electrician fixed the broken light.
words.ex_cn: 电工修好了坏掉的灯。
words.en: An electrician is a person whose job is to install and repair electrical equipment.

words.ex: Water is made of two elements: hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水由两种要素组成：氢和氧。
words.en: An element is a substance that cannot be separated into simpler substances by chemical means and is composed of atoms having the same number of protons.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.tr: adj. 环境的；有关环境的；
words.ex: The government is protecting the environmental balance.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在保护环境平衡。
words.en: Relating to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.

words.ex: He called an emergency doctor when he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 当他感到不舒服时，他叫了急诊医生。
words.en: An emergency is an unexpected and usually dangerous situation that calls for immediate action.

words.ex: He calls 911 for emergencies.
words.ex_cn: 他有紧急情况时拨打911。
words.en: Emergencies are serious, unexpected, and often dangerous situations requiring immediate action.

words.ex: The factory reduces emission to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 工厂减少排放以保护环境。
words.en: An emission is the production and discharge of something, especially gas or radiation.

words.ex: The lamp emits a soft light.
words.ex_cn: 灯发出柔和的光。
words.en: To emit means to send out something such as light, heat, sound, gas, etc.

words.ex: The teacher put emphasis on reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调每天都要阅读。
words.en: Special importance, value, or prominence given to something.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.ex: I like all fruits, especially apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢所有的水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: You use especially to emphasize that what you are saying applies more to one thing or situation than to others.

words.ex: The company will employ five new workers next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司下个月将雇佣五名新员工。
words.en: If a person or company employs you, they pay you to work for them.

words.ex: The employee arrived at work early.
words.ex_cn: 这位雇员早早到达了工作地点。
words.en: An employee is a person who is paid to work for an organization or for another person.

words.ex: The employer gave her a raise.
words.ex_cn: 雇主给她加了薪。
words.en: An employer is a person or organization that employs people, paying them for their work.

words.ex: He found employment after graduating from university.
words.ex_cn: 他大学毕业后找到了工作。
words.en: the condition of having paid work

words.ex: My teacher encourages me to speak English every day.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师鼓励我每天说英语。
words.en: If you encourage someone, you give them confidence, for example by letting them know that what they are doing is good and telling them that they should continue to do it.

words.tr: 短语动词. 鼓励某人做某事
words.ex: My teacher encourages me to speak English every day.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师鼓励我每天说英语。
words.en: To give someone support, confidence, or hope to do something.

words.tr: v. 使遭危险或伤害；危害；危及
words.ex: Pollution can endanger animals.
words.ex_cn: 污染会危及动物。
words.en: To put someone or something at risk or in danger.

words.tr: n. 事件；大事；比赛项目；
words.ex: The school event was fun for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 学校的活动对每个人都很有趣。
words.en: An event is something that happens, especially when it is unusual or important.

words.ex: China uses a lot of energy from coal.
words.ex_cn: 中国使用大量煤炭能源。
words.en: Energy is the ability and strength to do active physical things and the feeling that you are full of physical power and life.

words.ex: This country uses nuclear energy to make electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家使用核能来发电。
words.en: Nuclear energy is the energy released during nuclear fission or fusion, especially when used to generate electricity.

words.ex: The ever-increasing noise makes it hard to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 不断增加的噪音让人难以入睡。
words.en: Continuously becoming greater in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: It is evident that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is evident, it is easy to see, perceive, or understand.

words.ex: Exercise can enhance your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提高你的健康。
words.en: To enhance something means to improve its value, quality, or attractiveness.

words.ex: The car exceeded the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车超过了限速。
words.en: To be greater in quantity, degree, or intensity than something else.

words.ex: I enjoy eating ice cream on hot days.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在热天吃冰淇淋。
words.en: If you enjoy something, you find pleasure and satisfaction in doing it or experiencing it.

words.ex: The picnic was an enjoyable day with friends.
words.ex_cn: 野餐是和朋友一起度过的愉快一天。
words.en: Something that is enjoyable gives you pleasure.
