words.ex: The company plans to enlarge its office space.
words.ex_cn: 公司计划扩大其办公空间。
words.en: To make something bigger or more extensive.

words.tr: v. 扩大；膨胀；更充分地阐述；
words.ex: The company plans to expand its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划将其业务扩大到其他国家。
words.en: To increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way.

words.tr: phrase. 拓宽视野；开阔眼界
words.ex: Traveling abroad can broaden one's horizon.
words.ex_cn: 出国旅行可以拓宽一个人的视野。
words.en: To expand one's understanding or experience, especially by encountering new ideas, cultures, or perspectives.

words.tr: phrase. 拓宽某人的视野；扩大某人的见识
words.ex: Reading books can enlarge one's vision.
words.ex_cn: 读书可以拓宽一个人的视野。
words.en: To broaden one's perspective or understanding of the world through new experiences or knowledge.

words.ex: The elephant is enormous.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象非常巨大。
words.en: If you describe something as enormous, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large in size or amount.

words.ex: The movie was enormously popular.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极度受欢迎。
words.en: To a very great degree or extent; extremely.

words.tr:
adv. 足够地；充分地；
adj. 足够的；充足的；
int. 够了；
words.ex: He didn't run fast enough to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得不够快，没能赢得比赛。
words.en: as much or as many as required.

words.tr: n. 入会；入学 ；登记；注册；加入人数
words.ex: His enrollment in the club was approved last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周被批准加入该俱乐部。
words.en: The act of officially joining a course, school, etc., or the number of people who do this.

words.ex: Please ensure the door is locked.
words.ex_cn: 请确保门锁好了。
words.en: To make certain that something will occur or be the case.

words.ex: He enters the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄地进入房间。
words.en: To come or go into a place; to become involved in a situation or activity; to begin a particular period or stage; to record information in a book or computer.

words.ex: The clown entertains the children with funny tricks.
words.ex_cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏娱乐孩子们。
words.en: To entertain someone means to amuse or interest them, for example by telling them stories or jokes, or by playing music for them.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.ex: He is entirely happy with the result.
words.ex_cn: 他完全对结果感到满意。
words.en: Completely; without exception.

words.ex: They will extend the deadline by one week.
words.ex_cn: 他们将截止日期延长一周。
words.en: To extend something means to make it longer or larger, or to spread it over a larger area.

words.tr: phrase. 大家庭；扩大的家庭（如数代同堂的家庭）
words.ex: He lives with his extended family in a big house.
words.ex_cn: 他和大家庭住在一起，住在一所大房子里。
words.en: A family group that consists of parents, children, and other close relatives, often living in close proximity.

words.ex: The extent of his knowledge surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的知识广度让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The area or length to which something extends.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.ex: He works in financial planning.
words.ex_cn: 他从事财政规划工作。
words.en: Relating to finance or the management of large amounts of money.

words.tr: phrase. 财务支持；经济援助
words.ex: He got financial support from his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他从父母那里获得了经济支持。
words.en: Financial support refers to the provision of money or resources to help someone or something, especially in the context of education, business, or personal needs.

words.ex: He is financially independent from his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他在经济上独立于他的父母。
words.en: In a way that relates to money or how money is managed.

words.ex: He fills the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子装满水。
words.en: To make or become full; to put something into a container or space so that it is completely or almost completely full.

words.tr:
n. 电影；底片；薄薄的一层；
v. 拍摄电影；
words.ex: I watched a funny film last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚看了一部有趣的电影。
words.en: A film is a series of moving pictures, usually shown in a cinema or on television and often telling a story.

words.tr:
n. 金融；财务；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: He works in finance in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事金融工作。
words.en: Finance is the management of large amounts of money, especially by governments or large companies.

words.tr:
adj. 第一的；
adv. 首先；第一；
n. 第一；
words.ex: He got the first prize in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第一名。
words.en: A fist is the hand with the fingers bent in towards the palm and held tightly there, typically in order to strike a blow or grasp something.

words.tr: n. 设施；特色功能；特定场所；资质；
words.ex: The school has a new sports facility.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个新的体育设施。
words.en: A facility is a place, building, or service that is designed for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 因素；要素；倍数；
v. 把…因素包括进去；
words.ex: Weather is a factor in the game's outcome.
words.ex_cn: 天气是比赛结果的一个因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, decision, or situation.

words.tr:
v. 符合；合身；
adj. 健康的；适合的；
words.ex: This shirt fits me well.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫很合我的身。
words.en: If something fits, it is the right size and shape to go onto a person's body or onto a particular object.

words.ex: The factory makes cars.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂生产汽车。
words.en: A factory is a large building where machines are used to make goods in large quantities.

words.ex: The city has many factories that make cars.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市有许多制造汽车的工厂。
words.en: Factories are buildings or groups of buildings where goods are manufactured or assembled chiefly by machine.

words.tr: adj. 固定的；不能变的； v. 修理；固定；确定；“fix”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He has a fixed schedule every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都有一个固定的日程。
words.en: If something is fixed, it is attached or positioned so that it cannot move, or is arranged in a particular way and cannot be changed.

words.tr: v. 无法做到；失败；不及格；倒闭；
words.ex: He failed to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他没能完成比赛。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or do not succeed in doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 未能做某事；没有成功完成
words.ex: He failed to finish his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他没能按时完成作业。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or you do not succeed in doing it.

words.tr: n. 航班；飞行；（阶梯的）一段；
words.ex: The flight to Beijing leaves at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 飞往北京的航班早上8点起飞。
words.en: A flight is a journey made by flying, usually in an aircraft.

words.tr: phrase. 动力飞行；机动飞行（指使用发动机驱动的飞行）
words.ex: The boy loves motorised flight with his toy drone.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩喜欢用他的玩具无人机进行动力飞行。
words.en: Flight powered by an engine, as opposed to gliding or human-powered flight.

words.ex: He is a famous singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的歌手。
words.en: Known about by many people.

words.tr: adj. 接着的；下列的； prep. 在...之后； v. 跟随；“follow”的现在分词； n. 下列各项；
words.ex: The following day, we went to the park.
words.ex_cn: 接着的那天，我们去了公园。
words.en: Coming after or as a result of something; a group of supporters or admirers.

words.tr:
n. 农场；农庄；
v. 耕种；
words.ex: He works on a small farm with cows and chickens.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个养牛和鸡的小农场工作。
words.en: A farm is an area of land, together with the buildings on it, that is used for growing crops or raising animals.

words.tr: n. 农事；耕作；养殖； v. 务农；“farm”的现在分词；
words.ex: Farming is hard work in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 农事在乡村是很辛苦的工作。
words.en: Farming is the activity of growing crops or keeping animals on a farm.

words.ex: She loves to follow the latest fashion.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢追随最新的时尚。
words.en: Fashion is a popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time.

words.tr:
adv. 迅速；
adj. 快的；迅速的；
words.ex: He runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快。
words.en: Moving or capable of moving at high speed.

words.ex: He runs faster than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得比他弟弟快。
words.en: Comparative of fast: moving or capable of moving at high speed.

words.ex: He plays football with his friends every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末和朋友踢足球。
words.en: A game played by two teams of eleven players with a round ball that may not be touched with the hands or arms during play except by the goalkeepers. The object of the game is to score goals by kicking or heading the ball into the opponents' goal.

words.tr:
n. 害怕；惧怕；
v. 害怕；惧怕；
words.ex: He felt a deep fear when he saw the snake.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到蛇时，感到深深的害怕。
words.en: An unpleasant emotion caused by the threat of danger, pain, or harm.

words.ex: He loves eating foreign food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃什么外国食物。
words.en: belonging to or connected with a country that is not your own

words.tr: phrase. 外国公司；在本国以外注册或总部位于国外的企业
words.ex: He works for a foreign company in Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 他在北京一家外国公司工作。
words.en: A business entity based in a different country from where it operates, often subject to international regulations.

words.ex: He is learning a foreign language at school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学校学习一门外语。
words.en: A language that is not the native language of a particular person or group of people.

words.ex: The foreigner asked for directions to the train station.
words.ex_cn: 这位外国人问了去火车站的路。
words.en: A foreigner is a person who comes from a country other than your own.

words.ex: He walks in the forest every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在森林里散步。
words.en: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.

words.tr:
n. 形式；表格；形状；
v. 组成；建立；
words.ex: The form of the poem is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的形式非常简单。
words.en: A form is a particular way in which a thing exists or appears, or a document with spaces in which to write information.

words.tr: 短语. 一种……的形式；某种形式的
words.ex: This is a form of art.
words.ex_cn: 这是一种艺术形式。
words.en: A particular type or category of something, characterized by specific features or qualities.

words.ex: He wore a formal suit to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一套正式的西装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is formal is done or said according to an established or conventional way, especially in an official or serious situation.

words.ex: The boy found a fossil in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在岩石中发现了一块化石。
words.en: A fossil is the remains or impression of a prehistoric organism preserved in petrified form or as a mold or cast in rock.

words.ex: Cars use fossil fuel to move.
words.ex_cn: 汽车使用化石燃料行驶。
words.en: Fossil fuels are fuels formed by natural processes such as anaerobic decomposition of buried dead organisms, containing energy originating in ancient photosynthesis.

words.tr:
n. 领域；田地；场地；运动场；
v. 处理，应付（问题、电话等）；
words.ex: He works in the field of computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机科学领域工作。
words.en: A field is an area of land that is used for a particular purpose, such as growing crops or playing sports.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.tr:
adj. 第四的；
n. 第四个；
adv. 第四；
words.ex: He finished in fourth place.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第四名。
words.en: The fourth item in a series is the one that you count as number four.

words.tr:
adj. 免费的；自由的；
adv. 免费地；自由地；
v. 释放；
words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆在周日免费入场。
words.en: If someone is free, they are able to do what they want to do, or go where they want to go, without being controlled or restricted.

words.ex: They set free the bird from the cage.
words.ex_cn: 他们把鸟从笼子里放了。
words.en: To release someone or something from confinement or restraint.

words.ex: He wants freedom to speak his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他想要自由地表达自己的想法。
words.en: The condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints.

words.ex: Children can play freely in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们可以在公园里自由地玩耍。
words.en: If you can do something freely, you can do it without being controlled or restricted by anyone.

words.ex: He makes frequent trips to the city.
words.ex_cn: 他经常去城市。
words.en: If something is frequent, it happens often.

words.ex: He frequently visits his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他经常去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: If something happens frequently, it happens often.

words.tr: adj. 新鲜的；新的；刚发生的；
words.ex: She bought fresh apples from the market.
words.ex_cn: 她从市场买了新鲜的苹果。
words.en: Fresh food has been picked or produced recently, and has not been preserved, for example by being frozen or put in a tin.

words.ex: He drinks fresh water every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝淡水。
words.en: Water that is not salty, especially water found in rivers and lakes, which is suitable for drinking and irrigation.

words.ex: He put the milk in the fridge.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A fridge is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.tr:
n. 水果；
v. 结果实；
words.ex: I like fruit.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果。
words.en: The edible part of a plant that develops from a flower, especially one that is sweet and contains seeds.

words.ex: The town is near the frontier of the country.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇靠近国家的边境。
words.en: A frontier is a border between two countries or the area close to it. It can also refer to the limit of knowledge or the most advanced or recent stage in the development of something.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.tr:
adj. 满的；充满的；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The glass is full of water.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃杯装满了水。
words.en: Containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space.

words.ex: The box is full of toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子里装满了玩具。
words.en: To contain or hold as much or as many as possible; to be filled with something.

words.tr: phrase. 全日制教育；全日制学习
words.ex: He is in full time education at the local school.
words.ex_cn: 他在当地学校接受全日制教育。
words.en: Education pursued on a full-time basis, typically requiring a student's primary commitment during standard working hours.

words.tr: phrase. 全职工作；需要每天工作固定较长时间的职位
words.ex: He has a full-time job at a bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有一份全职工作。
words.en: A full-time job is a job in which you work the full number of hours considered normal or standard.

words.tr: adv. 完全地；充分地；彻底地；
words.ex: He fully understands the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他完全理解这个问题。
words.en: Completely or entirely; to the fullest extent.

words.ex: He worked hard to fulfill his dream.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的梦想。
words.en: To fulfill a task, role, or function means to do or perform it as required or expected.

words.tr:
n. 功能；职责；
v. 起作用；
words.ex: The function of this button is to turn on the light.
words.ex_cn: 这个按钮的功能是打开灯。
words.en: A function is the purpose that something is designed to have or the job that someone is employed to do. It can also refer to a mathematical relationship or a social event.

words.tr:
n. 基金；资金；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: The school raised a fund for new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校为购买新书筹集了一笔基金。
words.en: A sum of money saved or made available for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 支持这些资金；为资金提供支援
words.ex: The government must support the funds for public schools.
words.ex_cn: 政府必须支持这些用于公立学校的资金。
words.en: To provide financial assistance or backing for a project, cause, or organization.

words.tr: n. 资金；款项；拨款； v. “fund”的现在分词；
words.ex: The school needs more funding for new books.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校需要更多资金来购买新书。
words.en: Funding is money which is used to pay for a particular activity or to help achieve a particular purpose.

words.ex: The blacksmith heated the metal in the furnace.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠在熔炉里加热金属。
words.en: A furnace is a device that produces heat for warmth or to melt materials.

words.tr:
n. 未来；将来；前途；
adj. 将来的；未来的；
words.ex: We cannot predict the future.
words.ex_cn: 我们无法预测未来。
words.en: The future is the time after the present, or the events that will happen then.

words.tr:
v. 获得；增加；
n. 增益；获得；
words.ex: He gained a new skill last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月获得了一项新技能。
words.en: To gain means to obtain something that is useful, that gives you an advantage, or that is in some way positive, especially over a period of time.

words.ex: She plants flowers in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种花。
words.en: A garden is a piece of land next to a house, with flowers, vegetables, other plants, and often grass.

words.tr: n. 差距；隔阂；缺口；缝隙；
words.ex: There is a big gap between rich and poor.
words.ex_cn: 富人和穷人之间有很大的差距。
words.en: A gap is a space between two things or a hole in the middle of something solid.

words.tr: n. 气体；气态；汽油；天然气；煤气；
words.ex: Oxygen is a gas that we need to breathe.
words.ex_cn: 氧气是一种我们呼吸所需的气体。
words.en: Gas is a substance like air that is neither liquid nor solid and burns easily. It is used as a fuel for cooking and heating.

words.tr:
adj. 一般的；普遍的；总的；大致的；首席的；
n. 将军；
words.ex: He gave a general answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个一般的回答。
words.en: A general is a high-ranking officer in the army or air force. In other contexts, general refers to something that is common, usual, or not specific.

words.ex: My generation grew up with smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 我们这一代人是伴随着智能手机长大的。
words.en: A generation is all the people in a group or country who are of a similar age, especially when they are considered as having the same experiences or attitudes.

words.ex: He loves geography and learns about countries and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢地理学，学习各国和河流的知识。
words.en: The study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.ex: He gave up doing sports because he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他因为累了而放弃了运动。
words.en: To stop doing something that you do regularly, especially something that is bad for you.

words.ex: The window is made of glass.
words.ex_cn: 这扇窗户是玻璃做的。
words.en: Glass is a hard, brittle substance, typically transparent or translucent, made by fusing sand with soda, lime, and sometimes other ingredients and cooling rapidly.

words.ex: The problem is a global issue.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题是一个全球性的问题。
words.en: relating to the whole world; worldwide

words.ex: Globalization helps countries trade more easily.
words.ex_cn: 全球化帮助各国更容易地进行贸易。
words.en: The process by which businesses or other organizations develop international influence or start operating on an international scale.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种商品。
words.en: Goods are items that are made to be sold.

words.ex: The king governed the land for 50 years.
words.ex_cn: 国王统治这个国家50年。
words.en: To govern a country or an organization means to officially control and manage its affairs.

words.ex: The government provides free education.
words.ex_cn: 政府提供免费教育。
words.en: The group of people who officially control a country or the system used for controlling a country.

words.tr: phrase. 中央政府；国家最高行政管理机构
words.ex: The central government is responsible for setting national policies.
words.ex_cn: 中央政府负责制定国家政策。
words.en: The national government of a country, as opposed to the governments of its individual states or regions.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.ex: My family came to my graduation.
words.ex_cn: 我的家人来参加我的毕业典礼。
words.en: Graduation is the successful completion of a course of study at a university, college, or school, often marked by a ceremony.

words.tr: n. 祖父母；外祖父母；爷爷奶奶；
words.ex: I visit my grandparents every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我每个周末都去看望我的祖父母。
words.en: Grandparents are the parents of a person's father or mother.

words.ex: The children play on the grass after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在草地上玩耍。
words.en: Grass is a very common plant consisting of large numbers of thin, spiky, green leaves that cover the surface of the ground.

words.tr:
adj. 极好的；大的；伟大的；
adv. 很好地；
words.ex: This is a great movie!
words.ex_cn: 这是一部极好的电影！
words.en: If you describe someone or something as great, you approve of them or admire them.

words.tr: adj. 较大的；程度较重的；
words.ex: This box is greater than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子比那个大。
words.en: You use greater to indicate that something is larger in size, degree, or importance than something else.

words.ex: This is the greatest number of students in our class.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们班人数最多的时候。
words.en: The superlative form of great, used to describe something that is the largest in size, extent, or degree, or the most important or significant.

words.ex: He spends a great deal of time on homework.
words.ex_cn: 他花大量时间做作业。
words.en: A large amount; to a great extent.

words.ex: He greatly improved his English.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语进步了很多。
words.en: To a great extent or degree; very much.

words.ex: He is greedy and always wants more candy.
words.ex_cn: 他很贪婪，总是想要更多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe someone as greedy, you mean that they want to have more of something such as food or money than is necessary or fair.

words.tr:
n. 组；群；集团；
v. （使）形成组；
words.ex: The students are in a group of five.
words.ex_cn: 这些学生组成一个五人小组。
words.en: A group is a number of people or things that are located, gathered, or classed together.

words.tr: v. 生长；成长；渐渐变成；种植；
words.ex: The plant grows quickly in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物在春天长得很快。
words.en: If someone or something grows, they increase in size, amount, or degree, often over a period of time.

words.ex: He wants to grow up and be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他想长大后当一名医生。
words.en: To grow up means to gradually change from being a child to being an adult. This process involves physical, emotional, and intellectual development.

words.tr: adj. 增加的；增长的；增强的； v. 生长；成长；种植；渐渐变成；“grow”的现在分词； n. 成长；
words.ex: The growing demand for clean water is a big problem.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水日益增加的需求是一个大问题。
words.en: Increasing in size or amount; developing.

words.ex: The growth of the plant is slow in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这植物在冬天生长缓慢。
words.en: The process of increasing in physical size, number, value, or strength.

words.tr: 短语动词. 帮助促进经济增长
words.ex: New technology helps economic growth.
words.ex_cn: 新技术促进经济增长。
words.en: To contribute to the development and expansion of a nation's economy through various means.

words.ex: The policeman held a gun.
words.ex_cn: 警察拿着一把枪。
words.en: A gun is a weapon designed to discharge projectiles, often metal bullets, by the force of an explosive such as gunpowder.

words.ex: He has a habit of waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他有早起的习惯。
words.en: A habit is something that you do often or regularly.

words.ex: The accident happened yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 事故昨天发生了。
words.en: If something happens, it occurs as a result of a situation or course of action.

words.ex: Children find happiness in simple games.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在简单的游戏中找到幸福。
words.en: Happiness is a state of well-being and contentment.

words.ex: The child is happy when he plays with his toys.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子玩玩具时，他很快乐。
words.en: If you are happy, you are feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.

words.tr: adj. 感到（或显得）幸福的；幸福的( happy的比较级 )；
words.ex: She feels happier after talking to her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她和朋友聊完后感觉更幸福了。
words.en: Comparative form of happy. Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.

words.tr: adj. 最快乐的；最幸福的；
words.ex: He is the happiest boy in the class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上最快乐的男孩。
words.en: Superlative form of 'happy', meaning the most joyful or content.

words.tr:
adj. 困难的；坚硬的；费劲的；
adv. 努力地；
words.ex: This math problem is hard.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学题很难。
words.en: If something is hard, it is very difficult to do or deal with. It can also mean that something is solid and firm, not soft or liquid.

words.tr: phrase. 艰苦的工作；努力的工作
words.ex: He passed the exam through hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力学习通过了考试。
words.en: Hard work refers to a great deal of effort or labor.

words.tr:
n. 伤害；损害；
v. 伤害；损害；
words.ex: The storm caused great harm to the crops.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对庄稼造成了很大伤害。
words.en: To harm someone or something means to cause them physical injury or to damage them in some other way.

words.ex: Smoking can do harm to your lungs.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会对你的肺造成伤害。
words.en: To cause damage or injury to someone or something.

words.ex: Smoking is harmful to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有害。
words.en: Something that is harmful has a bad effect on something else, especially on a person's health.

words.ex: The small spider is harmless.
words.ex_cn: 这只小蜘蛛是无害的。
words.en: If someone or something is harmless, they are not dangerous and do not cause any harm.

words.tr: phrase. 上一节……的课；参加某一类课程
words.ex: I have a class of English every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我每周一上一节英语课。
words.en: To teach or instruct a group of students in a subject or course.

words.ex: He wears a black hat every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天戴一顶黑帽子。
words.en: A hat is a head covering which is worn for various reasons, including protection against weather conditions, ceremonial reasons such as university graduation, religious reasons, safety, or as a fashion accessory.

words.ex: Good food and sleep help maintain health.
words.ex_cn: 良好的饮食和睡眠有助于保持健康。
words.en: The condition of a person's body or mind, especially in terms of the presence or absence of illnesses, injuries, or impairments.

words.tr: phrase. 卫生保健；健康护理
words.ex: He works in health care as a nurse.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名护士从事医疗工作。
words.en: Health care refers to the organized provision of medical care to individuals or a community.

words.ex: She eats healthy food every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Someone who is healthy is well and is not suffering from any illness.

words.ex: Eating vegetables makes you healthier.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜让你更健康。
words.en: Comparative form of healthy; more healthy.

words.tr:
n. 热度；热；
v. 加热；
words.ex: The heat of the sun made the road hot.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的热度让路面变得很热。
words.en: Heat is a form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature. It can also refer to the level of excitement or intensity in a situation.

words.ex: This book is helpful for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这本书对学习英语有帮助。
words.en: If you describe someone as helpful, you mean that they help you in some way, such as doing part of your job for you or by giving you advice or information.

words.tr: adj. 生病的；坏的；不舒服的；
words.ex: He is ill and cannot go to school.
words.ex_cn: 他生病了，不能去上学。
words.en: If you are ill, you are suffering from a disease or a health problem.

words.ex: He stayed home because of illness.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病待在家里。
words.en: An illness is a particular disease, especially one that is not very serious.

words.tr: adv. 然而；不过；不论到什么程度；无论如何；
words.ex: I like coffee; however, I drink tea in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡；然而，我早上喝茶。
words.en: You use however when you are adding a comment which is surprising or which contrasts with what has just been said.

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.tr:
adj. 高的；
adv. 在高处；
words.ex: The mountain is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这座山很高。
words.en: If something is high, it is a long way above the ground, above sea level, or above a particular point.

words.ex: The company will hire a new manager next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司下周将雇用一位新经理。
words.en: If you hire someone, you employ them or pay them to do a particular job for you.

words.ex: Children have a strong imagination.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们有很强的想象力。
words.en: The ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind of things that are new and exciting, or not real.

words.tr: adj. 有历史意义的；历史性的；
words.ex: This is a historic moment for our country.
words.ex_cn: 这是对我们国家有历史意义的时刻。
words.en: Something that is historic is important in history, or potentially so.

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.tr: phrase. 历史景点；历史名胜
words.ex: Tourists visit historical attractions in the old city.
words.ex_cn: 游客参观老城的历史景点。
words.en: Places of interest that have significant historical value or are associated with historical events.

words.ex: He likes to read history books about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读关于古罗马的历史书籍。
words.en: History is the study of past events, particularly in human affairs.

words.ex: He uses a hi-tech phone to work faster.
words.ex_cn: 他用一部高科技手机来更快地工作。
words.en: Hi-tech refers to advanced technological development, especially in electronics and computer technology.

words.tr:
n. 高科技
adj. 高技术的
words.ex: He works in a high-tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家高科技公司工作。
words.en: Involving or using advanced technology.

words.ex: The importance of homework is clear.
words.ex_cn: 作业的重要性是显而易见的。
words.en: The quality or state of being important; significance.

words.ex: It is important to eat healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 吃健康的食物很重要。
words.en: Something that is important is very significant, is highly valued, or is necessary.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.ex: The government imposed a new tax on sugar.
words.ex_cn: 政府对糖征收了一项新税。
words.en: To impose means to officially force a rule, tax, punishment, etc. to be obeyed or received.

words.ex: He works hard to improve his English.
words.ex_cn: 他努力改善自己的英语。
words.en: To make something better, or to become better.

words.tr: adj. 不精确的；不准确的；有错误的；
words.ex: The clock is inaccurate and shows the wrong time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟不精确，显示的时间不对。
words.en: If a statement or measurement is inaccurate, it is not correct or not exact.

words.ex: The incidence of flu increased last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天流感的发生率上升了。
words.en: The incidence of something is the frequency with which it occurs or the rate at which it happens.

words.ex: The package includes a free book.
words.ex_cn: 这个套餐包括一本免费的书。
words.en: If one thing includes another, it has the other thing as one of its parts.

words.tr:
v. 增加；增多；
n. 增加；增长；
words.ex: The company increased its profits last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年增加了利润。
words.en: To increase something means to make it larger in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr: adj. 增长的；增多的； v. 增加；“increase”的现在分词；
words.ex: The increasing population needs more food.
words.ex_cn: 增长的人口需要更多的食物。
words.en: Becoming greater in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: People are increasingly using smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 人们日益使用智能手机。
words.en: More and more; gradually becoming greater in amount or degree.

words.ex: He lives independently and makes his own decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他独立生活，并自己做决定。
words.en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so that the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

words.ex: The dark clouds indicate rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云表明要下雨了。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.tr:
n. 个人；
adj. 个别的；单独的；
words.ex: Each individual has the right to speak freely.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有权自由发言。
words.en: An individual is a person considered separately from their society or community. As an adjective, it describes something that is single, separate, or unique to a person or thing.

words.ex: Each student must complete the task individually.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生必须单独完成任务。
words.en: If something is done individually, it is done separately to each person or thing in a group.

words.ex: He works in the tech industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在科技行业工作。
words.en: Industry is the work and processes involved in collecting raw materials, and making them into products in factories.

words.ex: These industries make cars and phones.
words.ex_cn: 这些行业制造汽车和手机。
words.en: Industries are groups of companies that produce goods or provide services that are similar or related to each other.

words.tr:
n. 影响（力）；
v. 影响；
words.ex: The teacher had a big influence on her students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对……有很大影响
words.ex: Teachers have great influence on students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生有很大影响。
words.en: To have a significant effect or impact on someone or something.

words.ex: He is an influential teacher in our school.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们学校一位有影响力的老师。
words.en: Having great influence on someone or something.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 发布信息；公告信息；张贴信息
words.ex: He posts information about the event on social media.
words.ex_cn: 他在社交媒体上发布有关该活动的信息。
words.en: To share or publish details, data, or news publicly, typically online.

words.ex: The city needs better infrastructure for roads and water.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要更好的道路和供水设施。
words.en: The basic physical and organizational structures and facilities (e.g., buildings, roads, power supplies) needed for the operation of a society or enterprise.

words.ex: He wakes up early in order to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早起是为了赶上公交车。
words.en: with the purpose of achieving something

words.tr: adj. 不安全的；无保障的；缺乏自信的；无把握的
words.ex: He feels insecure when he is alone at night.
words.ex_cn: 当他晚上一个人时，他感到不安全。
words.en: If you are insecure, you lack confidence because you think that you are not good enough or are not loved.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you do one thing instead of another, you do the first thing and not the second thing, especially as the result of a choice or a change of behaviour.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: In place of someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 宁可 ... 也不愿；与其 ... 倒不如；而不是
words.ex: He chose to walk rather than take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。
words.en: used to say that one thing is preferred to another or happens instead of another

words.ex: The hospital is a public institution.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院是一家公共机构。
words.en: An institution is a large important organization such as a university, church, or bank.

words.ex: The house has good insulation to keep warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有良好的绝缘层以在冬天保暖。
words.en: Insulation is a material or substance that is used to stop heat, electricity, or sound from going from one place to another.

words.tr:
adj. 智力的；
n. 知识分子；
words.ex: He is an intellectual person who loves solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱解决数学问题的智力型人。
words.en: An intellectual is someone who spends a lot of time studying and thinking about complicated ideas.

words.tr: adj. 有才智的；聪明的；明智的；
words.ex: The intelligent boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个有才智的男孩很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

words.ex: I intend to go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我打算明天去公园。
words.en: If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

words.ex: He uses the internet to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用因特网来查找信息。
words.en: The internet is a global system of interconnected computer networks that use the Internet protocol suite (TCP/IP) to link devices worldwide.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.ex: He played soccer in the past.
words.ex_cn: 他过去踢足球。
words.en: At a time before the present; in earlier times.

words.ex: He will introduce his friend to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他将向全班介绍他的朋友。
words.en: If you introduce someone, you tell someone else their name so that they can know each other.

words.tr: phrase. 提出并推动一项法律的制定；正式提交法案
words.ex: The government will introduce a law to protect children.
words.ex_cn: 政府将推出一项保护儿童的法律。
words.en: To introduce a law means to propose or bring forward a new piece of legislation for consideration and approval by a legislative body.

words.ex: The telephone was a great invention.
words.ex_cn: 电话是一项伟大的发明。
words.en: An invention is a unique or novel device, method, composition or process. It may be an improvement upon a machine or product, or a new process for creating an object or a result. An invention that achieves a completely unique function or result may be a radical breakthrough. Such works are novel and not obvious to others skilled in the same field.

words.ex: She invited her friend to dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她邀请她的朋友吃晚饭。
words.en: To invite someone means to ask them to come to a social event or to spend time with you socially.

words.ex: The project involves simple math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目包括简单的数学和写作。
words.en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

words.tr: adj. 偏远的；隔离的；孤独的； v. 使隔离；“isolate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The village is isolated, far from any city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄很偏远，远离任何城市。
words.en: If something is isolated, it is far away from other places, buildings, or people.

words.tr: n. 一件物品或商品；项目；一则；
words.ex: This item is on sale for $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件商品正在促销，售价5美元。
words.en: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

words.ex: He got a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周找到了一份新工作。
words.en: A job is the work that someone does regularly in order to earn money.

words.ex: He has high job satisfaction because he likes his work.
words.ex_cn: 他工作满意度很高，因为他喜欢自己的工作。
words.en: Job satisfaction refers to the level of contentment employees feel with their job, which can be influenced by various factors such as work environment, salary, and opportunities for advancement.

words.ex: He wants job security because he has a family to support.
words.ex_cn: 他想要工作保障，因为他要养家。
words.en: Job security refers to the probability that an individual will keep their job; a job with a high level of job security is one with a low risk of unemployment.

words.ex: He wants to join the football team.
words.ex_cn: 他想加入足球队。
words.en: To become a member of a group or organization; to connect or fasten things together.

words.ex: The journalist wrote a story about the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 记者写了一篇关于地震的文章。
words.en: A journalist is a person whose job is to collect news and write about it for newspapers, magazines, television, or radio.

words.tr:
n. 法官；裁判；
v. 判断；评判；
words.ex: The judge announced the verdict in court.
words.ex_cn: 法官在法庭上宣布了判决。
words.en: A judge is a person who has the authority to decide questions brought before a court of law. To judge means to form an opinion or conclusion about something.

words.tr: n. 废旧杂物；无价值的东西；
words.ex: He cleaned up the junk in his garage.
words.ex_cn: 他清理了车库里那些废旧杂物。
words.en: Old or discarded articles that are considered useless or of little value.

words.tr: adv. 仅仅；就；只是；刚刚；恰好；
words.ex: He just wants to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅想睡觉。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is exactly the case or is happening at this moment.

words.tr: v. 证明...正当；“justify”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有正当理由的；
words.ex: He justified his actions by telling the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他通过讲真话来证明自己的行为是正当的。
words.en: If you describe a decision, action, or idea as justified, you think it is reasonable and acceptable because it is based on facts or good reasons.

words.tr: adj. 不能证明为正当的；无可辩解的；没有道理的
words.ex: The price increase was deemed unjustifiable by the consumers.
words.ex_cn: 消费者认为价格上涨是不合理的。
words.en: If you describe something as unjustifiable, you mean that it cannot be justified because it is wrong or unacceptable.

words.ex: He gave a justification for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他为迟到提供了一个正当的理由。
words.en: A justification for something is an acceptable reason or explanation for it.

words.tr:
adv. 最小；最少；
adj. 最少的；最小的；
n. 最小；最少；
words.ex: He ran the least among all the runners.
words.ex_cn: 他在所有跑步者中跑得最少。
words.en: You use least to indicate that something is the smallest in amount, degree, or size, or the lowest in importance.

words.ex: I need at least three apples to make a pie.
words.ex_cn: 我至少需要三个苹果来做派。
words.en: You use at least to say that a number or amount is the smallest that is possible or likely and that the actual number or amount may be greater. The forms at the least and at the very least are also used.

words.tr:
v. 离开；离去；留下；
n. 休假；
words.ex: He will leave the room after class.
words.ex_cn: 他下课后会离开房间。
words.en: To go away from a place or a person.

words.ex: She took maternity leave after her baby was born.
words.ex_cn: 她生完孩子后休了产假。
words.en: A period of absence from work granted to a mother before and after the birth of her child.

words.ex: The professor gave a lecture on history.
words.ex_cn: 教授上了一节历史课。
words.en: A lecture is a talk that someone gives in order to teach people about a particular subject, often at a university or college.

words.ex: He reads books in his leisure.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间读书。
words.en: Leisure is the time when you are not working and you can relax and do things that you enjoy.

words.ex: She keeps the room clean every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天保持房间干净。
words.en: To continue to have or hold something; to maintain a condition or position.

words.tr:
n. 辩论；讨论；
v. 辩论；讨论；
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: If you maintain something, you continue to have it, and do not let it stop or grow weaker.

words.ex: The temperature remains high during summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天温度保持很高。
words.en: If someone or something remains in a particular state or condition, they stay in that state or condition and do not change.

words.ex: The length of the table is two meters.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的长度是两米。
words.en: The measurement or extent of something from end to end; the greater of two or the greatest of three dimensions of a body.

words.ex: I have math lesson every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我每周一都有数学课。
words.en: A lesson is a period of time in which someone is taught about a particular subject or how to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 使不进入；阻止入内；远离
words.ex: Please keep the dog out of the room.
words.ex_cn: 请别让狗进房间。
words.en: To prevent someone or something from entering a place; to exclude.

words.tr:
n. 水平；程度；等级；
adj. 平齐的；
v. 使平坦；
words.ex: His English level is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平很高。
words.en: A level is a point on a scale, for example a scale of amount, quality, or difficulty.

words.tr:
adj. 关键的；
n. 钥匙；关键；
words.ex: This is a key step to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是解决问题的关键步骤。
words.en: A key is a specially shaped piece of metal that you place in a lock and turn in order to open or lock a door, or to start or stop the engine of a vehicle.

words.ex: He goes to the library every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午去图书馆。
words.en: A library is a building where books, documents, CDs, and sometimes videos and music are kept for people to read, study, or borrow.

words.ex: He goes to libraries to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他去图书馆读书。
words.en: A place where books, magazines, and other materials (such as videos and musical recordings) are available for people to use or borrow.

words.ex: The school is five kilometers from my house.
words.ex_cn: 学校离我家五公里。
words.en: A kilometer is a unit of length in the metric system, equal to one thousand meters.

words.ex: She enjoys simple life in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢乡村里的简单生活。
words.en: Life is the existence of an individual human being or animal.

words.tr: phrase. 预期寿命；平均寿命
words.ex: Life expectancy has increased in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家的预期寿命已经增加。
words.en: The average period that a person may expect to live.

words.ex: He lives a 24/7 lifestyle, working and texting all day and night.
words.ex_cn: 他过着24/7的生活方式，整天整夜地工作和发信息。
words.en: The way in which a person lives is their lifestyle.

words.tr: phrase. 过……的生活；过着……的日子
words.ex: They lead a simple life in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他们在乡下过着简单的生活。
words.en: To live a particular kind of life.

words.tr: phrase. 过……的生活方式；采取……的生活模式
words.ex: He leads a healthy lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他过着健康的生活方式。
words.en: To adopt a particular way of living, often implying a specific habit or routine.

words.tr:
n. 缺乏；短缺；
v. 缺乏；短缺；
words.ex: There is a lack of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄缺乏干净的水。
words.en: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it or it does not exist at all.

words.tr:
n. 土地；陆地；
v. 降落；着陆；
words.ex: The farmer owns a large piece of land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有一大片土地。
words.en: Land is an area of ground, especially one that is used for a particular purpose such as farming or building.

words.ex: He speaks English as his first language.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语作为他的第一语言。
words.en: Language is the system of communication in speech and writing that is used by people of a particular country or area.

words.tr: phrase. 使用人数很少的语言；小语种
words.ex: The language of few speakers is slowly disappearing.
words.ex_cn: 使用者很少的语言正在慢慢消失。
words.en: A language spoken by a small number of people, often at risk of extinction.

words.ex: He has a large house.
words.ex_cn: 他有一所大房子。
words.en: Something that is large is greater in size than usual or average.

words.tr:
adj. 最后的；最近的；
v. 持续；
adv. 最后；最近一次；
words.ex: This is the last chance to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 这是通过考试的最后机会。
words.en: Coming after all others in time or order; final.

words.tr:
adj. 晚的；迟的；已故的；
adv. 晚；迟；
words.ex: The train is late.
words.ex_cn: 火车晚点了。
words.en: After the expected, usual, or proper time.

words.tr:
adj. 最新的；最后的；最近的；
n. 最新事物；
words.ex: He bought the latest phone on the market.
words.ex_cn: 他买了市场上最新的手机。
words.en: The most recent or the newest.

words.ex: He broke the law and was arrested.
words.ex_cn: 他违反了法律，被逮捕了。
words.en: A law is a rule or set of rules for good behaviour which is considered right and important by the majority of people for moral, religious, or emotional reasons.

words.ex: The police caught the lawbreaker near the bank.
words.ex_cn: 警察在银行附近抓到了违法者。
words.en: A lawbreaker is someone who breaks the law.

words.ex: I learn English every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天学习英语。
words.en: To gain knowledge or skill by studying, practicing, being taught, or experiencing something.

words.ex: We should learn from our mistakes and not repeat them.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该从错误中学习，不再重蹈覆辙。
words.en: To gain knowledge or skill by studying, practicing, being taught, or experiencing something.

words.tr: phrase. 死记硬背式学习；机械学习
words.ex: He hates rote learning because it feels boring.
words.ex_cn: 他讨厌死记硬背，因为它感觉很无聊。
words.en: Rote learning is a memorization technique based on repetition.

words.tr: v. 离开；“leave”的过去式和过去分词； n. 左；左边； adj. 左边的； adv. 向左；在左边；
words.ex: He left the house early this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上早早离开了家。
words.en: If there is a certain amount of something left, or if you have a certain amount of it left, it remains when the rest has gone or been used.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: A leg is one of the limbs on which a person or animal walks and stands.

words.tr: adv. 较少地；更少地；“little”的比较级； adj. 更少的；“little”的比较级； pron. 较少；更少；
words.ex: He eats less sugar now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在吃得更少的糖。
words.en: You use less to indicate that there is a smaller amount of something than before or than average. You can use 'less' to indicate that something is smaller in size or degree than another thing.

words.ex: Let me help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 让我帮你做作业。
words.en: To allow or permit something to happen or someone to do something.

words.ex: A is the first letter in the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: A 是英语字母表中的第一个字母。
words.en: A letter is a written message that can be handwritten or printed on paper. It is usually sent in an envelope by post or messenger.

words.tr:
v. 躺；撒谎；
n. 谎言；
words.ex: The cat lies on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫躺在沙发上。
words.en: If someone is lying, they are saying something which they know is not true.

words.tr:
v. 举起；提起；抬起；
n. 电梯；搭便车；
words.ex: He lift the box with both hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用双手举起箱子。
words.en: To lift something means to move it to a higher position. A lift is a device that carries people or goods up and down inside buildings.

words.tr:
n. 光；灯；光线；
adj. 轻的；浅的；少量的；明亮的；
v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The light from the window brightened the room.
words.ex_cn: 窗户透进来的光让房间变亮了。
words.en: Light is the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible. It is also used to describe something that is not heavy or a source of illumination.

words.ex: He runs like a cheetah.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得像猎豹一样。
words.en: To find something enjoyable or agreeable; to have a positive feeling towards someone or something.

words.ex: He is likely to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能赢得比赛。
words.en: If something is likely, it will probably happen or is expected.

words.tr:
n. 限制；
v. 限制；
words.ex: The teacher set a limit on homework time.
words.ex_cn: 老师对作业时间设定了限制。
words.en: A limit is the greatest amount, extent, or degree of something that is possible.

words.tr: adj. 有限的； v. 限制；“limit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: We have limited time to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 我们完成这个项目的时间是有限的。
words.en: If something is limited, there is only a certain amount of it.

words.tr: adj. 无限制的；无限量的；
words.ex: He has unlimited access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他可以无限制地使用图书馆。
words.en: If something is unlimited, there is no limit to it.

words.ex: He drew a straight line on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一条直线。
words.en: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

words.tr:
n. 液体；
adj. 液态的；
words.ex: Water is a common liquid.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的液体。
words.en: A liquid is a substance which is not solid but which flows and can be poured, for example water.

words.tr:
n. 表；名单；
v. 列出；
words.ex: He wrote his name on the list.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的名字写在了表上。
words.en: A list is a set of items, especially names, written or printed one after the other.

words.tr:
v. 生活；居住；活着；
adj. 活的；现场的；实况转播的；
words.ex: They live in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。
words.en: To live means to be alive, to have your home in a particular place, or to spend your life in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 独居；独自生活；一个人住
words.ex: He lives alone in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 他一个人住在一所小房子里。
words.en: To reside by oneself without the company of others.

words.tr: phrase. 离家生活；不在家居住
words.ex: He lives away from home to work in another city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在他乡工作，远离家。
words.en: To reside in a location other than one's permanent or family home.

words.ex: He bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他从本地市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: Something that is local relates to a particular area or to the area where you live.

words.ex: The government helps local areas with money and resources.
words.ex_cn: 政府为地方地区提供资金和资源。
words.en: Geographical areas within a town, city, or region that are close to a specific point.

words.ex: The local community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 当地社区一起清理了公园。
words.en: A local community is a group of people living in the same place or having a particular characteristic in common, often sharing interests and goals.

words.ex: The store sells locally grown vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售本地种植的蔬菜。
words.en: In or referring to a particular area or neighborhood, especially the one where you live or are at the moment.

words.tr: v. 确定…的位置；使坐落于；查找…的地点；
words.ex: Can you locate the hotel on the map?
words.ex_cn: 你能在地图上找到酒店的位置吗？
words.en: To locate something means to find out exactly where it is, or to establish something in a particular place.

words.tr:
v. 看；看上去；
n. 看；
words.ex: He looks at the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他看着天空。
words.en: To direct your eyes in a particular direction.

words.ex: She looks after her little brother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To take care of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 寻找一名雇员；招聘员工
words.ex: The company is looking for an employee to join the team.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司正在寻找一名员工加入团队。
words.en: To seek and recruit a person for a job position.

words.ex: He looks like his father.
words.ex_cn: 他看起来像他的父亲。
words.en: To resemble or seem similar to someone or something in appearance.

words.ex: He lost his keys yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天丢了钥匙。
words.en: If you lose something, you no longer have it or you cannot find it.

words.tr: adj. 丢失的； v. 丢失；输；“lose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The lost keys were found under the table.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙在桌子下面找到了。
words.en: If you are lost, you do not know where you are or you are unable to find your way.

words.ex: The company suffered a big loss last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年遭受了巨大损失。
words.en: Loss is the fact of no longer having something or having less of it than you used to have, or the process by which this happens.

words.ex: There are a lot of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: A lot refers to a large number or amount of something. It can also mean a piece of land or someone's fate or destiny.

words.tr:
v. 热爱；爱；
n. 爱；爱情；爱好的事物；
words.ex: I love playing football with my friends.
words.ex_cn: 我热爱和朋友们一起踢足球。
words.en: Love is a very strong feeling of affection towards someone that you are romantically or sexually attracted to.

words.tr:
adj. 低沉的；低垂的；
adv. 低；低矮；在低处；往下地；
words.ex: He spoke in a low voice to avoid waking the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他用低沉的声音说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: If something is low, it is close to the ground, the bottom, or the base of something.

words.ex: He won the lottery by pure luck.
words.ex_cn: 他纯粹是靠运气中了彩票。
words.en: Luck is the force that causes things, especially good things, to happen to you by chance and not as a result of your own efforts or abilities.

words.ex: He is lucky to win the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他很幸运赢得了奖品。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as lucky, you mean that they have something which is very desirable or that they are in a very desirable situation.

words.ex: I eat lunch at noon every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天中午吃午餐。
words.en: A meal eaten in the middle of the day, typically one that is lighter or less formal than an evening meal.

words.ex: The factory uses a big machine to make cars.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用一台大机器制造汽车。
words.en: A machine is a piece of equipment which uses electricity or an engine in order to do a particular kind of work.

words.tr: n. 机械（总称）；机械装置；
words.ex: The factory uses old machinery to produce goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用旧机械来生产产品。
words.en: Machinery refers to machines in general or the parts of a machine that make it work.

words.ex: He reads a magazine every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上读一本杂志。
words.en: A magazine is a type of thin book with large pages and a paper cover which contains articles, photographs, and advertisements, usually on a particular subject or aimed at a particular readership.

words.ex: The main reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The most important part or aspect of something.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；
n. 大调；主修课；
words.ex: Math is a major subject in school.
words.ex_cn: 数学是学校里的主要科目。
words.en: A major is a student's principal field of study or specialization in college or university.

words.ex: People live in major cities for better jobs.
words.ex_cn: 人们住在大城市是为了更好的工作。
words.en: In the primary, most populous, or economically significant cities of a country or region.

words.ex: He mainly eats vegetables and fruit.
words.ex_cn: 他主要吃蔬菜和水果。
words.en: You use mainly to indicate that a statement is true in most cases or to a large extent.

words.ex: The majority of students like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 大多数学生喜欢披萨。
words.en: The majority is the greater number or part of something.

words.tr:
adj. 男性的；雄性的；
n. 男性；雄性；
words.ex: The male bird has bright red feathers.
words.ex_cn: 这只雄鸟有鲜艳的红色羽毛。
words.en: A male is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that cannot have babies. In humans, males are usually considered to be boys or men.

words.ex: Good management helps a company grow.
words.ex_cn: 良好的管理有助于公司发展。
words.en: The control and organization of something, especially a business and its employees.

words.tr:
n. 制造；
v. （用机器大量）制造；虚构；捏造；
words.ex: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的制造需要很多工人。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.tr: phrase. 制造能力；生产能力
words.ex: The factory increased its manufacture capacity last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂去年提高了生产能力。
words.en: The maximum amount of goods or products a factory or system can produce.

words.tr:
adj. 许多的；
pron. 许多人或物；
words.ex: Many students like to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A large number of.

words.ex: He uses a map to find the way.
words.ex_cn: 他用地图找路。
words.en: A map is a visual representation of an area, showing physical features, cities, roads, etc., typically on a flat surface.

words.ex: He works in marketing for a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家科技公司从事营销工作。
words.en: Marketing involves the process of promoting, selling, and distributing a product or service. It includes market research and advertising.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.ex: He loves mathematics because it is logical.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它有逻辑性。
words.en: Mathematics is the study of numbers, shapes, and patterns using reason and usually a special system of symbols and rules for organizing them.

words.tr:
n. 事情；物质；
v. 要紧；
words.ex: What's the matter with you?
words.ex_cn: 你怎么了？
words.en: Matter is a physical substance in general, as distinct from mind and spirit; (in physics) that which occupies space and possesses rest mass, especially as distinct from energy. It can also refer to a subject or situation under consideration.

words.ex: No matter how tired I am, I finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 无论我多么累，我都会完成作业。
words.en: used to say that something is not important or does not affect the situation

words.tr: 某事不重要；某事无关紧要
words.ex: It does not matter what you wear.
words.ex_cn: 你穿什么没关系。
words.en: It is not important or significant; it has no bearing on the situation.

words.ex: The talk was meaningless and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这场谈话毫无意义且无聊。
words.en: If something is meaningless, it has no meaning, or seems to have no meaning.

words.tr:
v. 意思是说；表示…的意思；
n. 手段；方法；收入；
words.ex: This sign means you cannot park here.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志意思是说这里不能停车。
words.en: Means refers to a method or way of doing something, or the resources or assets available for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 采取措施；采取行动（以应对某种情况或解决问题）
words.ex: The government will take measures to stop pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府将采取措施来阻止污染。
words.en: To take measures means to do something in order to achieve a particular result or to solve a problem.

words.ex: The measurement of temperature is important in science.
words.ex_cn: 温度的衡量在科学中很重要。
words.en: The action of measuring something.

words.ex: He eats meat every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃肉。
words.en: Meat is the flesh of an animal that is eaten as food.

words.ex: The mechanic fixed my car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 机修工很快修好了我的车。
words.en: A mechanic is a person whose job is to repair and maintain machines and engines, especially those of vehicles.

words.ex: The media reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 媒介迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: The main means of mass communication (broadcasting, publishing, and the Internet), regarded collectively.

words.ex: He works in a medical center.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家医疗中心工作。
words.en: Relating to the science or practice of medicine.

words.ex: He needs better medical care after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后需要更好的医疗照顾。
words.en: The provision of what is necessary for the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease and the maintenance of health.

words.ex: He wants to study medicine at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习医学。
words.en: Medicine is the science or practice of the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

words.ex: He is a member of the school club.
words.ex_cn: 他是学校俱乐部的成员。
words.en: A member is a person who belongs to a group such as a club, organization, or team.

words.ex: He relies on memorization to pass his history test.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠死记硬背来通过历史考试。
words.en: The act or process of committing something to memory or learning something by heart.

words.ex: He has a mental illness.
words.ex_cn: 他有心理疾病。
words.en: Relating to the mind or involving the process of thinking.

words.ex: I got your message this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上收到了你的消息。
words.en: A message is a piece of information or a request that you send to someone or leave for them when you cannot speak to them directly.

words.ex: He found a new method to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种解决这个问题的新方法。
words.en: A method is a particular way of doing something.

words.tr: v. 可能；也许；“may”的过去式； n. 强大力量；
words.ex: He might come to the party tonight.
words.ex_cn: 他今晚可能会来参加派对。
words.en: Might is used to indicate that something is possible or might happen, or to ask for permission in a polite way.

words.tr:
adj. 军事的；军用的；
n. 军队；武装力量；
words.ex: The military base is near the border.
words.ex_cn: 军事基地靠近边境。
words.en: relating to or characteristic of soldiers or armed forces

words.tr: phrase. 军事力量；武装部队
words.ex: The country sent its military force to protect the border.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家派出了军队去保护边境。
words.en: Military force refers to the armed forces of a country, including the army, navy, and air force, used for defending the country and conducting warfare.

words.tr:
v. 滥用；误用；虐待
n. 滥用；误用；虐待
words.ex: He misuses his phone during class.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时滥用手机。
words.en: The incorrect or improper use of something.

words.ex: The recipe calls for a mixture of flour and water.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和水的混合物。
words.en: A mixture is a substance made by combining other substances together.

words.tr: 移动电话：便携式的无线通信设备，用于进行语音通话、发送短信、上网等功能。
words.ex: Children use mobile phones to call their parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们用手机给父母打电话。
words.en: A mobile phone is a portable telephone that can make and receive calls over a radio frequency link while the user is moving within a telephone service area.

words.ex: This house has a modern design.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子具有现代的设计。
words.en: Modern means relating to the present time, for example the present decade or present century.

words.ex: I need the money for the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我需要这笔钱来付账单。
words.en: Money is the coins or bank notes that you use to buy things, or the amount of these that you have.

words.ex: He runs a profit-making business.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家盈利的企业。
words.en: A profit-making organization or business is one that makes a profit.

words.ex: He started a money-making blog.
words.ex_cn: 他创办了一个赚钱的博客。
words.en: The activity or process of earning or making money, especially as a primary goal of a business or enterprise.

words.ex: He will return next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月回来。
words.en: A month is one of the twelve periods of time that a year is divided into, for example January or February.

words.tr:
adj. 道德的；道义上的；
n. 寓意；
words.ex: It is a moral duty to tell the truth.
words.ex_cn: 说实话是一种道德责任。
words.en: Concerned with the principles of right and wrong behavior and the goodness or badness of human character.

words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.tr:
n. 模具；霉；
v. 铸造；
words.ex: The clay was poured into the mould to shape the pot.
words.ex_cn: 将黏土倒入模具中以塑造花盆。
words.en: A mould is a hollow container that you pour a liquid or soft substance into, which then becomes solid in the same shape as the container. Mould can also refer to a fungus that grows on old food or on damp surfaces.

words.tr:
v. 移动；搬家；
n. 行动；移动；
words.ex: Please move the chair.
words.ex_cn: 请移动椅子。
words.en: To change position or to cause something or someone to change position, especially in a particular direction or to a particular place.

words.tr: n. 运动；动作；活动；乐章；
words.ex: The movement of the sun changes the shadow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的运动改变了影子。
words.en: The act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place.

words.ex: The multi-colored flowers brightened the garden.
words.ex_cn: 五颜六色的花让花园变得明亮。
words.en: A prefix meaning 'many' or 'multiple', used in the formation of compound words to indicate the involvement of more than one of the specified element.

words.tr:
adj. 多媒体的；
n. 多媒体；
words.ex: The school uses multimedia tools to teach students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用多媒体工具来教学。
words.en: Multimedia is the use of computers to present text, graphics, video, animation, and sound in an integrated way.

words.tr: adj. 多文化的；多元文化的
words.ex: The school has a multi-cultural festival every year.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校每年都有一个多元文化的节日。
words.en: Relating to or involving multiple cultures or ethnic groups.

words.ex: He works for a multinational company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家跨国公司工作。
words.en: A multinational company is a corporation that has its facilities and other assets in at least one country other than its home country. Such companies have offices and/or factories in different countries and usually have a centralized head office where they coordinate global management.

words.ex: We visited a museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.ex: He loves listening to music every night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天晚上听音乐。
words.en: Music is the pattern of sounds produced by people singing or playing instruments.

words.ex: He is a musician who plays the guitar.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位弹吉他的音乐家。
words.en: A musician is a person who plays a musical instrument, especially as a profession, or is musically talented.

words.tr:
auxv. 必须；一定要；
n. 必须做的事；必不可少的事物；
words.ex: You must finish your homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 你必须在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is very likely or certain to be true or to happen.

words.tr:
n. 姓名；名称；
v. 说出…的名字；命名；
words.ex: His name is Tom.
words.ex_cn: 他的名字是汤姆。
words.en: The word or words that a person, thing, or place is known by.

words.ex: The nation celebrated its independence day.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家庆祝了它的独立日。
words.en: A nation is a country considered as a group of people with the same language, culture, and history, who live in a particular area under one government.

words.ex: The national flag flies high every morning.
words.ex_cn: 每天早上国旗都高高飘扬。
words.en: relating to or characteristic of a nation; common to a whole nation

words.ex: Children play games on national children's day.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在六一儿童节玩游。
words.en: A day dedicated to celebrating and advocating for the rights and well-being of children in a nation.

words.ex: On national non-smoking day, people stop smoking to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 在国家无烟日，人们戒烟以保持健康。
words.en: An annual observance promoting the benefits of quitting smoking and raising awareness about tobacco-related health issues.

words.tr: phrase. 民族认同；国家认同；国民身份认同感
words.ex: He feels strong national identity when he sees his country's flag.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到自己国家的国旗时，他感到强烈的国家认同。
words.en: National identity refers to a person's identity or sense of belonging to one state or to one nation. It is the sense of a nation as a cohesive whole, as represented by distinctive traditions, culture, and language.

words.ex: His nationality is Canadian.
words.ex_cn: 他的国籍是加拿大人。
words.en: Nationality is the legal relationship between an individual and a state, often used to refer to the country to which a person belongs.

words.ex: The children played in the natural park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在自然公园里玩耍。
words.en: Existing in or caused by nature; not made or caused by humankind.

words.ex: The children learn about the natural environment in school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校学习自然环境。
words.en: The natural environment encompasses all living and non-living things occurring naturally, meaning not made or caused by humankind.

words.ex: He uses natural gas to cook dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他用天然气做饭。
words.en: Natural gas is a fossil fuel formed when layers of buried plants and animals are exposed to intense heat and pressure over thousands of years.

words.ex: His nature is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的本性是善良且有耐心的。
words.en: Nature refers to the physical world and everything in it that is not made by people, including plants, animals, mountains, oceans, stars, etc. It can also refer to the basic or inherent features, character, or qualities of something.

words.ex: He joined the navy after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他高中毕业后加入了海军。
words.en: The navy is the part of a country's armed forces that is trained to operate at sea.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；必要的；必然的；
words.ex: Water is necessary for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命所必需的。
words.en: If something is necessary, it is needed in order for something else to happen or be done.

words.tr: phrase. 需要去做；必须做；有必要做
words.ex: I need to do my homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我需要在晚饭前做作业。
words.en: An obligation or requirement to perform an action.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.ex: He responded negatively to the proposal.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个提议持消极态度。
words.en: In a manner that is negative or pessimistic.

words.ex: My neighbour gives me apples from his tree.
words.ex_cn: 我的邻居从他的树上给我摘苹果。
words.en: A neighbour is someone who lives near you, especially in the next house or flat.

words.tr: n. 街坊；四邻；街道；附近地区；
words.ex: I walk my dog in the neighborhood every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上在街坊遛狗。
words.en: A neighborhood is one of the parts of a town where people live.

words.ex: I read the news every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上看新闻。
words.en: News is information about recent events or happenings, especially as reported by newspapers, radio, television, or online media.

words.ex: The news media reported the accident yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 新闻媒体昨天报道了这起事故。
words.en: The news media refers to the various mass communication outlets that provide news and information to the public, including newspapers, television, radio, and the internet.

words.ex: He reads the newspaper every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读报纸。
words.en: A newspaper is a publication consisting of a number of large sheets of folded paper, on which news, advertisements, and other information is printed.

words.tr: phrase. 在报纸上阅读新闻
words.ex: He reads news in the newspaper every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在报纸上读新闻。
words.en: To obtain information about current events by reading a physical, printed periodical.

words.ex: The stars are bright at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚星星很亮。
words.en: The period of darkness in each twenty-four hours; the time from sunset to sunrise.

words.ex: Plants need nitrogen to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要氮来生长。
words.en: A chemical element with the symbol N and atomic number 7. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless gas that is the most plentiful element in Earth's atmosphere and is a constituent of all living tissues.

words.ex: The noise from the street kept me awake.
words.ex_cn: 街道上的噪声让我睡不着。
words.en: Noise is a sound, especially one that is loud, unpleasant, or disturbing.

words.ex: He no longer plays soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他不再踢足球了。
words.en: If something is no longer the case, it is not the case now, although it was the case in the past.

words.ex: Nowadays, many children use tablets to learn.
words.ex_cn: 现在，许多孩子用平板电脑学习。
words.en: At the present time, in contrast with the past.

words.ex: The number on the door is 5.
words.ex_cn: 门上的数字是5。
words.en: A number is a word or symbol that represents an amount or a quantity.

words.ex: A large number of students passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 大量的学生通过了考试。
words.en: Used to indicate a considerable quantity of something or many instances of something.

words.ex: An increasing number of students like math.
words.ex_cn: 喜欢数学的学生越来越多。
words.en: A growing quantity of something, often used to indicate a trend or change over time.

words.ex: The number of students is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 学生的人数在增加。
words.en: The phrase 'the number of' refers to the quantity or count of something, typically used to indicate how many of a particular thing there are.

words.ex: There are numerous books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: If people or things are numerous, they exist or are present in large numbers.

words.ex: The nurse gave the patient medicine.
words.ex_cn: 护士给病人服了药。
words.en: A nurse is a person whose job is to care for people who are ill or injured, especially in a hospital.

words.ex: Children must obey their parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子必须遵守父母的规定。
words.en: To obey means to do what you are told or expected to do according to a rule, law, or someone with authority over you.

words.tr: phrase. 遵守规则；服从规定
words.ex: The children obey rules at school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校遵守规则。
words.en: To follow instructions or regulations without question.

words.ex: He felt an obligation to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有义务帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An obligation is something that you must do because you have promised, because of a law, etc.

words.ex: He obtained a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周获得了一份新工作。
words.en: If you obtain something, you get it or achieve it.

words.tr: phrase. 获取信息；获得情报
words.ex: To obtain information, you can search the internet, read books, or consult experts.
words.ex_cn: 要获取信息，你可以上网搜索、阅读书籍或咨询专家。
words.en: To acquire knowledge or facts about a subject through study or experience.

words.ex: She wore a dress for the occasion.
words.ex_cn: 她为了这个特殊场合穿了一条裙子。
words.en: An occasion is a particular time when something happens, or a special event.

words.ex: The ocean is very big and deep.
words.ex_cn: 海洋非常大且深。
words.en: The vast body of salt water that covers almost three quarters of the earth's surface.

words.tr:
v. 提供；
n. 提供；提议；报价；
words.ex: He offers help to his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他向同学提供帮助。
words.en: If you offer something to someone, you ask them if they would like to have it or use it.

words.ex: He works in an office downtown.
words.ex_cn: 他在市中心的一间办公室工作。
words.en: An office is a room or set of rooms where people work, especially in a business or organization.

words.ex: The officer gave a clear order to the soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 军官向士兵下达了明确的命令。
words.en: An officer is a person in a position of authority in the armed forces, the police, or a government organization.

words.ex: He often goes to the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后常常去公园。
words.en: Many times; frequently.

words.ex: She put oil on the pan before cooking.
words.ex_cn: 她在锅里倒了油再做饭。
words.en: Oil is a liquid that is used as a fuel and for lubricating the moving parts of machines.

words.ex: He watches the olympics every four years.
words.ex_cn: 他每四年观看奥运会。
words.en: The Olympics are an international sports festival that originated in ancient Greece and includes summer and winter sports competitions in which thousands of athletes from around the world participate.

words.tr:
conj. 一旦；一…便；
adv. 曾经；一次；
words.ex: Once you finish your homework, you can play.
words.ex_cn: 一旦你完成作业，就可以玩了。
words.en: At one time in the past; formerly.

words.tr:
adv. 在网上地；在线地；
adj. 联机的；在线的；
words.ex: He works online from home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家网上工作。
words.en: Connected to or available through a computer network, especially the Internet.

words.tr:
adv. 只；仅仅；只有；
adj. 唯一的；仅有的；
words.ex: He eats only apples for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐只吃苹果。
words.en: You use only to indicate the one thing that is true, appropriate, or important in a particular situation, in contrast to all the other things that are not true, appropriate, or important.

words.ex: He says he likes quiet, on the contrary, he always listens to loud music.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢安静，相反，他总是听大声的音乐。
words.en: You use 'on the contrary' when you are contradicting what has just been said or implied, or making a contrast between two things.

words.ex: He shared his opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他分享了他对这部电影的意见。
words.en: Your ideas or beliefs about a particular subject.

words.ex: He got an opportunity to work abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了一个去国外工作的机会。
words.en: An opportunity is a situation in which it is possible for you to do something that you want to do.

words.tr:
n. 反面；对立面；
adj. 对面的；
prep. 与…相对；
words.ex: The opposite of black is white.
words.ex_cn: 黑色的反面是白色。
words.en: If one thing is opposite another, it is on the other side of a space from it.

words.ex: He is optimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持乐观态度。
words.en: Someone who is optimistic is hopeful about the future or the success of something in particular.

words.tr: n. 乐观；乐观主义；乐观精神；
words.ex: His optimism helps him stay happy even when things are hard.
words.ex_cn: 他的乐观让他即使在困难时也能保持快乐。
words.en: Optimism is a feeling of hopefulness and confidence about the future or the success of something.

words.tr: adj. 可选择的；非强制的；
words.ex: The field trip is optional.
words.ex_cn: 这次郊游是可选的。
words.en: If something is optional, you can choose whether or not you do it or have it.

words.tr: adj. 普通的；平常的；一般的；
words.ex: He wore an ordinary shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件普通的衬衫去学校。
words.en: Something that is ordinary is not special or different in any way.

words.ex: Ordinary people can make big changes.
words.ex_cn: 普通人也能带来巨大的改变。
words.en: Typical individuals, not famous, wealthy, or specially skilled.

words.ex: She will organize a meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她明天将安排一次会议。
words.en: To organize something means to arrange it in a systematic way, especially on a large scale.

words.ex: The organization helps poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: An organization is a group of people who work together in a structured way for a shared purpose.

words.ex: He helped others without asking for anything.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助别人，没有要求任何回报。
words.en: Used to refer to additional people or things of the same type as those already mentioned or known about.

words.ex: We had an outdoor picnic last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 上个星期天我们进行了户外野餐。
words.en: relating to or done in the open air; not inside a building

words.tr: phrase. /adv. 不在旺季的；不合时令的；反季节的；过季的
words.ex: The apples are out of season now.
words.ex_cn: 现在苹果不是应季水果。
words.en: Not available or not at the best time of year; not in season.

words.tr:
prep. 在...外；
n. 外面；外边；外部；
adv. 在外面；
adj. 外面的；外界的；
words.ex: The cat is sitting outside the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子外面。
words.en: The outer side or surface of something; not inside a building; external to a particular place or thing.

words.ex: The benefits outweigh the risks.
words.ex_cn: 好处超过了风险。
words.en: If one thing outweighs another, the first thing is of greater importance, benefit, or significance than the second thing.

words.ex: She put the cake in the oven.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。
words.en: An oven is a device for cooking food, using dry heat.

words.ex: He heats food in a microwave oven.
words.ex_cn: 他用微波炉加热食物。
words.en: A microwave oven is an oven that uses microwaves to cook or heat food.

words.tr:
prep. 遍于…之上；越过；
adv. 大于；结束；越过；
words.ex: The blanket is over the bed.
words.ex_cn: 毯子盖在床上面。
words.en: In addition to the meanings related to physical position or movement above something, 'over' can also indicate completion, excess, or repetition.

words.tr: v. 暴食；吃得过量；吃撑
words.ex: He overate at the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 他在生日聚会上吃太多了。
